literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 麻疹 传播 风险在 2025-2026 年 麻疹 之前 2-3 年在学校层面突破了流行病阈值,而县级估计值始终低于该阈值。 [10.1038/s41591-026-04612-2]
审查得出的结论是,麻疹病毒 传播 的潜力在学校中已经变得非常关键,但在当前 监测 系统监控的规模上仍然不可见。它还强调,大流行加剧了 疫苗 的犹豫,使平均敏感性增加了一倍,从大约 5% 增加到 10%。 [10.1038/s41591-026-04561-w]

纯政策组和对照组之间的 MCV1 覆盖率相似(调整后的风险差异 [ARD] = -1%、95%CI:-17%、15%),但在 5 剂转换组中,9 个月时的及时 MCV1(ARD = 18%、95%CI:7%、28%)和 MCV2 覆盖率(ARD = 17%、95%CI:1%、34%)显着上升,并且浪费下降(ARD = -7%,95%CI:-14%,-1%)。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129065]

该研究报告称,2024 年全国 疫苗接种 覆盖率达到 75.3%,比 2022 年的 65.3% 提高了 10 个百分点。显着的地理差异仍然存在 (p = 0.0233),大城市 (63.2%) 的覆盖率低于内陆地区 (78.4%) 和中等地区 (76.2%)。居住在大城市显着降低覆盖率(OR 调整 = 0.25;p = 0.010),而男孩性别(OR 调整 = 1.33;p = 0.040)、在医疗机构出生(OR 调整 = 1.38;p = 0.046)和拥有出生证明(OR 调整 = 2.30;p < 0.001)与较高的覆盖率相关。 [10.1371/journal.pgph.0006390]
研究发现,2026 年的 麻疹 流行病与 疫苗接种 发病率下降有关,受冲突影响的国家以及马尔代夫和赞比亚等和平国家报告了具体病例。在孟加拉国,疫苗 短缺和资金问题导致 麻疹 病例和死亡人数大幅上升。 [10.64628/aai.mjwgp6gch]

literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Measles transmission risk crossed the epidemic threshold at the school level 2–3 years before the 2025–2026 outbreaks, while county-level estimates consistently remained below that threshold. [10.1038/s41591-026-04612-2]

The review concludes that measles virus transmission potential has become supercritical in schools but remains invisible at the scale monitored by current surveillance systems. It also highlights that vaccine hesitancy, exacerbated by the pandemic, has doubled average susceptibility from approximately 5% to 10%. [10.1038/s41591-026-04561-w]

MCV1 coverage was similar between policy-only and control (adjusted risk difference [ARD] = -1%, 95%CI: -17%, 15%), but in the 5-dose switch group, timely MCV1 at 9 months (ARD = 18%, 95%CI: 7%, 28%) and MCV2 coverage (ARD = 17%, 95%CI: 1%, 34%) rose significantly, and wastage fell (ARD = -7%, 95%CI: -14%, -1%). [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129065]

The study reported a national post-campaign vaccination coverage of 75.3% in 2024, a 10-point increase from 65.3% in 2022. Significant geographical disparities persisted (p = 0.0233), with lower coverage in large cities (63.2%) compared to landlocked (78.4%) and intermediate (76.2%) districts. [10.1371/journal.pgph.0006390]

Overall measles IgG seropositivity was 84.59% (95% CI: 82.98–86.08%), with a GMT of 482.48 mIU/mL. Seropositivity varied significantly by region, ethnicity, age, and vaccination history. [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1919103]

news.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 爱荷华州卫生与公共服务部 (Iowa HHS) 确认爱荷华州出现 麻疹 暴发 病例,有 12 例病例,并有人传人的证据。这是爱荷华州 HHS 报告的已证实的事件。 [news-f7e2a25dfff772cb]
弗吉尼亚州卫生部 (VDH) 正在提高免疫意识,包括 麻疹 疫苗 建议,并确保儿童获得 疫苗接种。这是他们更广泛的公共卫生努力的一部分,但证据中没有详细说明已确认的 麻疹 暴发 或具体事件。 [news-7471d1f55dd63af5]
世卫组织与吉尔吉斯斯坦卫生部和红十字会与红新月会国际联合会合作,对吉尔吉斯斯坦的 麻疹 暴发 应对措施进行了评估。 [news-95bd737ff093ced2]
宾夕法尼亚州立大学卫生局向公众通报了戈利萨诺儿童医院可能存在 麻疹 暴露情况。宾夕法尼亚州立大学健康新闻报道。 [news-299346d73d6c8ff2]
佐治亚州公共卫生部 (DPH) 确认了亚特兰大都会区一名未接种疫苗的居民中出现 麻疹 病例。该事件已得到 DPH 的确认。 [news-41220487b2307ede]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Measles virus news developments.
key_findings_en: The Iowa Department of Health and Human Services (Iowa HHS) confirmed a measles outbreak in Iowa with 12 cases and evidence of person-to-person spread. This is a confirmed event reported by the Iowa HHS. [news-f7e2a25dfff772cb]

The Virginia Department of Health (VDH) is promoting immunization awareness, including measles vaccine recommendations, and ensuring access to childhood vaccinations. This is part of their broader public health efforts, but no confirmed measles outbreak or specific event is detailed in the evidence. [news-7471d1f55dd63af5]

WHO, in collaboration with the Kyrgyzstan Ministry of Health and the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, conducted an assessment of the measles outbreak response in Kyrgyzstan. [news-95bd737ff093ced2]
Penn State Health notified the public of a potential measles exposure at Golisano Children’s Hospital. Reported by Penn State Health News. [news-299346d73d6c8ff2]
The Georgia Department of Public Health (DPH) confirmed a measles case in an unvaccinated resident of metro Atlanta. The event is confirmed by DPH. [news-41220487b2307ede]

弗吉尼亚州卫生部 (VDH) 正在提高免疫意识,包括 麻疹 疫苗 建议,并确保儿童获得 疫苗接种。这是他们更广泛的公共卫生努力的一部分,但证据中没有详细说明已确认的 麻疹 暴发 或具体事件。 [news-7471d1f55dd63af5]。
世卫组织与吉尔吉斯斯坦卫生部和红十字会与红新月会国际联合会合作,对吉尔吉斯斯坦的 麻疹 暴发 应对措施进行了评估。 [news-95bd737ff093ced2]。
宾夕法尼亚州立大学卫生局向公众通报了戈利萨诺儿童医院可能存在 麻疹 暴露情况。宾夕法尼亚州立大学健康新闻报道。 [news-299346d73d6c8ff2]。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following Measles virus news developments.

The Iowa Department of Health and Human Services (Iowa HHS) confirmed a measles outbreak in Iowa with 12 cases and evidence of person-to-person spread. This is a confirmed event reported by the Iowa HHS.
The Virginia Department of Health (VDH) is promoting immunization awareness, including measles vaccine recommendations, and ensuring access to childhood vaccinations.

WHO, in collaboration with the Kyrgyzstan Ministry of Health and the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, conducted an assessment of the measles outbreak response in Kyrgyzstan.
Penn State Health notified the public of a potential measles exposure at Golisano Children’s Hospital. Reported by Penn State Health News. [news-299346d73d6c8ff2].

papers.title: County, district and community-level measles transmission in the United States in 2013−2025
papers.abstract: The United States declared measles eliminated in 2000. In 2025-2026, more than 3,500 cases have placed that status under formal review. Vaccine hesitancy, accelerated by COVID-19 disruption and misinformation, has eroded the immunological buffers sustaining elimination. Current surveillance compounds this threat: county-level vaccination aggregates structurally obscure the fine-scale susceptibility clustering where outbreaks originate. We assembled a nationwide multiscale vaccination database spanning 45 US states and Washington, DC (2013-2025), encompassing over 50,000 schools, 13,000 districts and 3,000 counties, and developed a transmission model to quantify epidemic risk across different spatial scales. School-level effective reproduction numbers crossed the epidemic threshold in 2022-2023, a transition invisible to aggregated surveillance. Average susceptibility doubled from approximately 5% to 10% following the pandemic. We also show that county boundary misalignment creates cross-boundary corridors that push well-vaccinated counties above threshold through spillover from less-vaccinated populations. State trajectories diverge markedly, shaped by exemption policies and vaccination infrastructure. The spatial architecture of US measles vulnerability has fundamentally shifted: transmission potential is supercritical in schools but invisible at the scale monitored by surveillance. Preventing measles re-endemicity requires surveillance and interventions operating at school and district levels, where imported cases can be intercepted before igniting sustained transmission.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines measles virus transmission in the United States from 2013 to 2025, focusing on how county, district, and community-level vaccination data influence the risk of outbreaks. The central question is whether the measles elimination status is under threat due to changes in vaccination coverage and susceptibility patterns.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review compiles a nationwide multiscale vaccination database spanning 45 US states and Washington, DC from 2013 to 2025, including over 50,000 schools, 13,000 districts, and 3,000 counties. It develops a transmission model to quantify epidemic risk across different spatial scales, using county-level vaccination aggregates and school-level effective reproduction numbers to assess transmission dynamics.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that measles virus transmission potential has become supercritical in schools but remains invisible at the scale monitored by current surveillance systems. It also highlights that vaccine hesitancy, exacerbated by the pandemic, has doubled average susceptibility from approximately 5% to 10%.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that county-level vaccination aggregates obscure fine-scale susceptibility clustering, making it difficult to detect outbreaks at their origin. It also identifies that county boundary misalignment creates cross-boundary corridors, allowing less-vaccinated populations to influence well-vaccinated counties.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: To prevent measles re-endemicity, the review recommends surveillance and interventions at the school and district levels, where imported cases can be intercepted before sustained transmission occurs. It emphasizes the need for localized strategies to address the shifting spatial architecture of measles vulnerability.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the transmission dynamics of the measles virus in the United States from 2013 to 2025, focusing on the impact of vaccination coverage and susceptibility patterns at county, district, and community levels. It highlights that the measles elimination status is under threat due to vaccine hesitancy, which has increased average susceptibility from 5% to 10% post-pandemic. The study reveals that school-level effective reproduction numbers have crossed the epidemic threshold, a trend invisible to aggregated surveillance. It also identifies cross-boundary corridors that allow less-vaccinated populations to influence well-vaccinated counties. The review concludes that preventing measles re-endemicity requires localized surveillance and interventions at the school and district levels, where outbreaks can be intercepted before they escalate. The findings underscore the need for more granular data and targeted strategies to address the evolving spatial patterns of measles vulnerability.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述考察了2013年至2025年美国的麻疹病毒 传播,重点关注县、区和社区级别的麻疹病毒数据如何影响暴发的风险。核心问题是 麻疹 消除状态是否因 麻疹 覆盖范围和易感性模式的变化而受到威胁。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查编制了2013年至2025年涵盖美国45个州和华盛顿特区的全国性多尺度疫苗接种数据库,包括超过50,000所学校、13,000个区和3,000个县。它开发了一个 传播 模型来量化不同空间尺度的流行病风险,使用县级 疫苗接种 总量和学校级有效繁殖数来评估 传播 动态。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,麻疹病毒 传播 的潜力在学校中已经变得非常关键,但在当前 监测 系统监控的规模上仍然不可见。它还强调,大流行加剧了 疫苗 的犹豫,使平均敏感性增加了一倍,从大约 5% 增加到 10%。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查指出,县级 疫苗接种 聚集了模糊的精细敏感性聚类,因此很难在其起源处检测到 暴发。它还指出,县边界错位会造成跨界走廊,使疫苗接种较少的人群能够影响疫苗接种良好的县。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了防止 麻疹 再次流行,审查建议在学校和学区层面采取 麻疹 和干预措施,可以在持续的 传播 发生之前拦截输入病例。它强调需要制定本地化策略来解决 麻疹 漏洞不断变化的空间结构。

papers.abstract_zh: 美国于 2000 年宣布消除 麻疹。2025 年至 2026 年,已有超过 3,500 起案件对该状态进行了正式审查。疫苗 的犹豫,加上 COVID-19 的破坏和错误信息,已经侵蚀了维持消除的免疫缓冲。当前的 监测 加剧了这种威胁:县级 疫苗接种 聚合在结构上掩盖了 暴发 起源的精细敏感性聚类。我们构建了覆盖美国 45 个州和华盛顿特区(2013-2025 年)的全国性多尺度 疫苗接种 数据库,涵盖 50,000 多所学校、13,000 个区和 3,000 个县,并开发了 传播 模型来量化不同空间尺度的流行病风险。2022年至2023年,学校层面的有效再生数跨越了流行病阈值,这一转变对于累计监测来说是不可见的。流感大流行后,平均易感性从约 5% 翻倍至 10%。我们还表明,县边界错位创建了跨界走廊,将疫苗接种良好的县从疫苗接种较少的人群中推至 跨物种溢出 阈值以上。受豁免政策和 疫苗接种 基础设施的影响,各州的发展轨迹明显不同。美国麻疹脆弱性的空间结构已经发生了根本性的转变:传播的潜力在学校中是超临界的,但在监测监测的范围内是看不见的。防止 麻疹 再次流行需要 麻疹 以及在学校和地区层面采取干预措施,在引发持续的 传播 之前可以拦截输入病例。

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了防止 麻疹 再次流行,审查建议在学校和学区层面采取 麻疹 和干预措施,可以在持续的 传播 发生之前拦截输入病例。它强调需要制定本地化策略来解决 麻疹 漏洞不断变化的空间结构。

papers.title: Measles Frontline Defense: The Pivotal Role of Emergency Nurses and Emergency Medical Services Personnel
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000. However, in 2025, the country experienced the highest number of cases reported in more than 2 decades. Furthermore, early 2026 data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicate a continued increase in case counts. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians frequently serve as the initial health care professionals who assess patients with fever and rashes. Prompt identification and swift isolation are essential to curtail measles transmission. This narrative literature review aims to provide practical, evidence-based guidance for emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians on the recognition, isolation, documentation, infection control, and coordination with public health authorities during measles outbreaks. METHODS: A narrative review synthesizing current Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and World Health Organization guidance was conducted. Peer-reviewed literature was identified through targeted searches in PubMed and Google Scholar using keywords, including measles, emergency department, prehospital, emergency nurse, emergency medical services, triage, and infection control, focusing on publications from 2015 to 2026. Studies providing practical guidance or epidemiologic data relevant to emergency medical settings were prioritized. RESULTS: Measles spreads through airborne transmission and can remain suspended in the air for up to 2 hours after an infected individual leaves an area. Early symptoms include fever, cough, coryza (runny nose and nasal congestion), and conjunctivitis, followed by a descending maculopapular rash (red rash with both flat areas and small bumps on the skin), which typically begins on the face and spreads downward. Proper triage assessment, infection-control measures, documentation within electronic health records, and timely communication with infection prevention and public health authorities are essential to interrupt the transmission. DISCUSSION: Measles remains one of the most contagious viral illnesses encountered in health care settings. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to recognize and halt the spread of measles. Clear triage and screening steps should be used, staff immunity should be confirmed, and close collaboration with infection prevention and public health teams is necessary to protect patients, families, and health care workers.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:麻疹 于 2000 年在美国宣布消除。然而,2025 年,该国报告的病例数达到了 20 多年来的最高水平。此外,疾病控制与预防中心 2026 年初的数据表明病例数持续增加。急诊护士和急诊医疗技术人员经常作为最初的医疗保健专业人员来评估发烧和皮疹患者。及时识别和迅速隔离对于遏制 麻疹 传播 至关重要。这篇叙述性文献综述旨在为急诊护士和急诊医疗技术人员在 麻疹 暴发 期间的识别、隔离、记录、感染控制以及与公共卫生当局的协调方面提供实用的、基于证据的指导。方法:进行了综合当前疾病控制与预防中心和世界卫生组织指南的叙述性回顾。通过使用 麻疹、急诊科、院前、急诊护士、紧急医疗服务、分诊和感染控制等关键词在 PubMed 和 Google Scholar 中进行有针对性的搜索来确定同行评审文献,重点关注 2015 年至 2026 年的出版物。优先考虑提供与紧急医疗环境相关的实用指导或流行病学数据的研究。结果:麻疹 通过空气中的 传播 传播,并在感染者离开某个区域后可在空气中悬浮长达 2 小时。早期症状包括发烧、咳嗽、鼻炎(流鼻涕和鼻塞)和结膜炎,随后出现下降的斑丘疹(皮肤上有平坦区域和小肿块的红色皮疹),通常从面部开始并向下蔓延。适当的分诊评估、感染控制措施、电子健康记录中的记录以及与感染预防和公共卫生当局的及时沟通对于中断 传播 至关重要。讨论:麻疹 仍然是医疗保健环境中最具传染性的病毒性疾病之一。急诊护士和急救医疗技术人员往往是最先识别并阻止 麻疹 传播的人。应采用明确的分类和筛查步骤,应确认工作人员的免疫力,并与感染预防和公共卫生团队密切合作,以保护患者、家庭和医护人员。

papers.title: Lessons from Ontario’s COVID-19 Vaccination Strategies: Implications for Preventing Measles Resurgence in Canada
papers.abstract: The resurgence of measles in Canada has raised concerns about poor vaccination coverage and disruptions to routine immunization programs following the COVID-19 pandemic. In 2025, Canada lost its measles elimination status due to sustained measles transmission across multiple provinces. The reported cases primarily involved populations that were unvaccinated or under-vaccinated. This paper reviews successful vaccination strategies implemented during COVID-19 and assesses their applicability to measles prevention efforts. The return of measles cases in Canada after the COVID-19 outbreak demonstrates some of the difficulties in sustaining immunization rates in the general population. Even though Canada eliminated measles from its territory in the past, some challenges remain today.

papers.title: Waning of vaccine-induced measles antibodies and population immunity gaps in the post-elimination era: a multicenter seroepidemiological study in China
papers.abstract: Background Despite sustained high measles-containing vaccine (MCV) coverage, maintaining population immunity after measles elimination remains challenging. This study aimed to characterize measles antibody persistence, identify immunity gaps, and evaluate factors associated with seronegativity in China. Methods A multicenter cross-sectional serological survey was conducted among 2,083 participants from Jiangsu Province and Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region during 2024–2025. Measles-specific IgG antibodies were measured using ELISA, with seropositivity defined as IgG ≥200 mIU/mL. Restricted cubic spline models were used to assess antibody kinetics after excluding individuals without documented vaccination, those sampled within one month after vaccination, and potential primary vaccine failures. Multivariable logistic regression and propensity score matching were performed to evaluate factors associated with seronegativity. Results Overall measles IgG seropositivity was 84.59% (95% CI: 82.98–86.08%), with a GMT of 482.48 mIU/mL. Seropositivity varied significantly by region, ethnicity, age, and vaccination history. Antibody levels showed a non-linear decline with increasing time since vaccination, and each additional year since the last vaccination increased seronegativity risk (AOR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.07–1.15). Children aged 8–17 months had the lowest seropositivity (28.13%), indicating a potential susceptibility window. Although migrants had higher seropositivity than permanent residents (93.04% vs. 83.90%), migration status was not independently associated with seronegativity after adjustment. Conclusions High MCV coverage does not necessarily ensure sustained population immunity in the post-elimination era. Waning humoral immunity, delayed vaccination, and heterogeneous vaccination histories contribute to residual susceptibility, highlighting the need for immunity-based surveillance and targeted interventions.

papers.source_body_en: Background Despite sustained high measles-containing vaccine (MCV) coverage, maintaining population immunity after measles elimination remains challenging. This study aimed to characterize measles antibody persistence, identify immunity gaps, and evaluate factors associated with seronegativity in China. Methods A multicenter cross-sectional serological survey was conducted among 2,083 participants from Jiangsu Province and Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region during 2024–2025. Measles-specific IgG antibodies were measured using ELISA, with seropositivity defined as IgG ≥200 mIU/mL. Restricted cubic spline models were used to assess antibody kinetics after excluding individuals without documented vaccination, those sampled within one month after vaccination, and potential primary vaccine failures. Multivariable logistic regression and propensity score matching were performed to evaluate factors associated with seronegativity. Results Overall measles IgG seropositivity was 84.59% (95% CI: 82.98–86.08%), with a GMT of 482.48 mIU/mL. Seropositivity varied significantly by region, ethnicity, age, and vaccination history. Antibody levels showed a non-linear decline with increasing time since vaccination, and each additional year since the last vaccination increased seronegativity risk (AOR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.07–1.15). Children aged 8–17 months had the lowest seropositivity (28.13%), indicating a potential susceptibility window. Although migrants had higher seropositivity than permanent residents (93.04% vs. 83.90%), migration status was not independently associated with seronegativity after adjustment. Conclusions High MCV coverage does not necessarily ensure sustained population immunity in the post-elimination era. Waning humoral immunity, delayed vaccination, and heterogeneous vaccination histories contribute to residual susceptibility, highlighting the need for immunity-based surveillance and targeted interventions.

papers.title: Quantifying the cost of measles outbreak in the U.S. and how costs scale with outbreak size
papers.abstract: In 2025, the United States experienced the largest number of measles cases since its elimination in 2000. These outbreaks require extensive public health responses to mitigate, consume substantial hospital resources, and impose an economic and financial burden on state and federal budgets. We conducted a literature review using PubMed as well as official CDC and state health department reports to identify studies published between January 1, 2000, and October 7, 2025, across all 50 states. We also examined how costs scale with outbreak size. A total of 120 articles were screened, 33 underwent full text review, and data were extracted from 19 articles, yielding outbreak relevant costs in 18 different states. Eight additional reports in the gray literature were identified. Outbreak size ranged from 1 to 802 cases. Average outbreak cost per case was estimated at $43,203.65, while the average cost per contact was $443.46. Average cost per case varied from $33,415.75 from the medical provider perspective to $58,591.50 when including public health response costs. Fixed costs of imitating public health responses were estimated at $297,746.94 (95% CI: $4537.86 - $590,956.02), with an incremental cost of $16,299.64 (95% CI: $15,301.96 - $17,297.32) per each additional case. The elasticity of the total costs with respect to outbreak size was estimated at 0.86 (95% CI: 0.65-1.07) Measles outbreaks in the U.S. continue to re-emerge and impose significant financial and public health burden. These outbreaks are largely preventable through inexpensive and highly effective measles vaccination paired with system-level preparedness for effective containment. Since fixed response costs for any outbreak can be costly, our estimates provide improved data on how costs of measles outbreaks scale with outbreak size by isolating incremental costs associated incident new cases, as well as incident contacts, for use alongside budgetary planning and modeled risk assessments.

papers.title: Estimating current susceptibility to measles in Australia following sustained measles elimination.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study estimates Australia's measles susceptibility across all age groups. To our knowledge, this study is the first internationally to combine multiple consecutive serosurvey and population immunisation register data. METHODS: We estimated age-specific measles susceptibility in 2019 using data from nationally representative seroprevalence surveys for people born between 1920 and 1960 (infection-acquired immunity) and those born 1961-1999 (infection/vaccine-acquired immunity). For people born 2000-2018 (vaccine-acquired immunity only), we estimated measles susceptibility from coverage of one or two doses of measles-containing vaccine from the Australian Immunisation Register and presumed vaccine effectiveness, adjusting for 0·04% waning of protection per year. RESULTS: Susceptibility increased from less than 1% across those born 1920-1960 to 11% for the 1993-1995 cohort, and ranged from 7-14% for those born 2000-2015. We estimated that 1.7 million Australians (6·7%) were susceptible to measles in 2019 (95%UI: 1·3-3·2 million). Among notifications of measles infection between 2008 and 2022, people aged 15-35 years at time of notification accounted for 50%. CONCLUSIONS: Despite sustained high two-dose measles vaccine coverage, Australia's overall population-level measles immunity is at the lower end of the World Health Organization estimated herd protection threshold range (93-95%). IMPLICATIONS FOR PUBLIC HEALTH: Our estimates provide baseline data to inform vaccination activities to address immunity gaps in older age groups, particularly those likely to travel internationally.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem of waning population immunity to measles in Australia despite sustained high vaccine coverage, identifying a knowledge gap about age-specific susceptibility after decades of elimination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This national ecological study combined seroprevalence surveys for cohorts born 1920–1999 with Australian Immunisation Register coverage data for cohorts born 2000–2018 to estimate age-specific measles susceptibility in 2019.
analysis.methods: Susceptibility for 1920–1960 was inferred from infection-acquired immunity in serosurveys, for 1961–1999 from combined infection- and vaccine-acquired immunity, and for 2000–2018 from one- or two-dose coverage adjusted for 0·04% annual waning of vaccine protection.
analysis.main_results: Susceptibility rose from <1% in those born 1920–1960 to 11% in the 1993–1995 cohort, ranged from 7–14% for those born 2000–2015, and an estimated 1.7 million Australians (6·7%) were susceptible in 2019 (95%UI: 1·3–3·2 million).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as showing Australia’s overall immunity at the lower end of the WHO herd-protection threshold (93–95%), and they highlight the novelty of combining serosurvey and immunisation register data across all age groups.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The estimates provide baseline data to guide vaccination activities targeting immunity gaps, particularly in older age groups and those likely to travel internationally.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s ecological design and reliance on register-based coverage with assumed waning rates limit causal inference, and the uncertainty interval around total susceptibility indicates moderate evidence strength.

analysis.summary_en: This national study estimated age-specific measles susceptibility in Australia for 2019 by integrating seroprevalence data from 1920–1999 cohorts with Australian Immunisation Register coverage for 2000–2018 cohorts, adjusting for 0·04% annual waning of vaccine protection. Susceptibility increased from <1% in those born 1920–1960 to 11% in the 1993–1995 cohort and ranged from 7–14% for those born 2000–2015, with an estimated 1.7 million Australians (6·7%) susceptible in 2019 (95%UI: 1·3–3·2 million). The authors interpret Australia’s overall immunity as being at the lower end of the WHO herd-protection threshold (93–95%) and note the novelty of combining serosurvey and immunisation register data across all age groups. These estimates inform targeted vaccination strategies to address immunity gaps, especially in older age groups and international travellers.

papers.title: Timeliness of measles vaccination in selected districts of Oromia Region, Ethiopia – 2021
papers.abstract: Background Delays in vaccination with the first/s dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. Methods A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24–35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Among children who received MCV, vaccination timing was classified as early (MCV1: <9 months; MCV2: <15 months), timely (MCV1: 9 to <10 months; MCV2: 15 to <16 months), or delayed (MCV1: ≥10 months; MCV2: ≥16 months). Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. Results Overall, 651 children aged 12–35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24–35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. Conclusions Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the timeliness of measles vaccination in Oromia Region, Ethiopia, following the introduction of MCV2 in 2019. A secondary analysis of a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months was conducted. The study found that MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, while MCV2 coverage was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was higher in urban areas compared to rural areas. The characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination varied between urban and rural settings, but common factors included caregiver awareness and service delivery aspects. The study emphasizes the need for catch-up vaccination policies and tailored strategies to improve measles vaccine coverage and timeliness. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of reported limitations.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 延迟 麻疹 与含 麻疹 的 疫苗(MCV1、MCV2)的首剂/次剂量会增加 麻疹 传播 的风险。MCV2 于 2019 年被添加到埃塞俄比亚的常规免疫计划中,在 15 个月大时接种。我们描述了 麻疹 疫苗接种 的年龄以及与 MCV2 引入后及时 疫苗接种 相关的特征。方法 对 2021 年埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚州 12-35 个月龄儿童进行的横断面家庭调查进行了二次分析。MCV 疫苗接种 状态和 疫苗接种 年龄是根据孩子的 疫苗接种 卡确定的。估计了按 疫苗接种 年龄划分的 MCV1 和 MCV2(24-35 个月儿童)的累积卡确认 疫苗接种 覆盖率。在接受 MCV 的儿童中,疫苗接种 时间分为早期(MCV1:<9 个月;MCV2:<15 个月)、及时(MCV1:9 至 <10 个月;MCV2:15 至 <16 个月)或延迟(MCV1:≥10 个月;MCV2:≥16 个月)。使用多元逻辑回归和城市/农村分层分析与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征。结果 总体而言,对 651 名 12-35 个月的儿童 (MCV1) 和 270 名 24-35 个月的儿童 (MCV2) 进行了分析。9 个月时的累积 MCV1 覆盖率为 59.9%,12 个月时为 76.3%,15 个月时的 MCV2 累积覆盖率为 33.0%,24 个月时为 44.8%。与农村地区相比,城市地区的 MCV 覆盖率普遍较高。接种儿童中,MCV1 早期接种、及时接种和延迟接种比例分别为 30.1%、44.5% 和 25.3%,MCV2 接种比例分别为 28.6%、41.2% 和 30.3%。与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征在城市和农村地区有所不同,但共同主题包括护理人员免疫意识和服务提供方面的提高。结论 虽然大多数接受 MCV1 的儿童在 12 个月大时就接种了疫苗,但许多人接受了延迟剂量。无论 疫苗接种 时间如何,MCV2 覆盖率都很低。研究结果强调了常规追赶疫苗接种政策和指导的重要性,以及在城乡环境中制定量身定制的策略以提高MCV覆盖率和及时疫苗接种的必要性。

papers.title: Ethiopia missed opportunities for vaccination study: Cluster-randomized evaluation of 5-dose measles vaccine vials and a flexible open-vial policy, 2021–2022
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: In 2024, an estimated 95,000 people died from measles globally, largely from suboptimal coverage with the measles-containing vaccine (MCV). Health workers may defer vaccinating eligible children to avoid wasting doses from 10-dose MCV vials, which must be discarded six hours after opening. These missed opportunities for vaccination (MOV) reduce coverage and timeliness. Ethiopia, which provides MCV at 9 and 15 months, considered switching to 5-dose vials. METHODS: We conducted a 15-month, randomized controlled trial with a nested cross-sectional design in Ethiopia. Sixty woredas were randomized to: (1) policy-only, instructing health workers to open 10-dose vials for any number of eligible children, with additional stock for increased wastage; (2) 5-dose switch, combining this policy with replacement of 10-dose by 5-dose vials; or (3) control (routine 10-dose practice). Household and health-facility surveys at baseline and endline assessed effects on first-dose (MCV1) and second-dose (MCV2) coverage, MCV1 timeliness, and wastage. Generalized estimating equation models estimated net intervention effects versus control. We also estimated the government cost of a nationwide 5-dose switch. RESULTS: MCV1 coverage was similar between policy-only and control (adjusted risk difference [ARD] = -1%, 95%CI: -17%, 15%), with no significant differences in MCV1 timeliness or MCV2 coverage. In the 5-dose switch group, MCV1 coverage changed little (ARD = 1%, 95%CI: -17%, 18%), but timely MCV1 at 9 months (ARD = 18%, 95%CI: 7%, 28%) and MCV2 coverage (ARD = 17%, 95%CI: 1%, 34%) rose significantly, and wastage fell (ARD = -7%, 95%CI: -14%, -1%). By endline, 29% of 5-dose health workers opened vials ≥10 times monthly (none in control); caregivers in both intervention groups reported 11% fewer measles-related MOVs. A nationwide 5-dose switch was estimated to save 17% in procurement cost per fully vaccinated (two-dose) child. CONCLUSIONS: The combined 5-dose intervention improved MCV1 timeliness and MCV2 coverage and reduced wastage, addressing a key operational barrier and potentially supporting measles elimination in Ethiopia.

These missed opportunities for vaccination (MOV) reduce coverage and timeliness. Ethiopia, which provides MCV at 9 and 15 months, considered switching to 5-dose vials. METHODS: We conducted a 15-month, randomized controlled trial with a nested cross-sectional design in Ethiopia. Sixty woredas were randomized to: (1) policy-only, instructing health workers to open 10-dose vials for any number of eligible children, with additional stock for increased wastage; (2) 5-dose switch, combining this policy with replacement of 10-dose by 5-dose vials; or (3) control (routine 10-dose practice). Household and health-facility surveys at baseline and endline assessed effects on first-dose (MCV1) and second-dose (MCV2) coverage, MCV1 timeliness, and wastage. Generalized estimating equation models estimated net intervention effects versus control. We also estimated the government cost of a nationwide 5-dose switch. RESULTS: MCV1 coverage was similar between policy-only and control (adjusted risk difference [ARD] = -1%, 95%CI: -17%, 15%), with no significant differences in MCV1 timeliness or MCV2 coverage. In the 5-dose switch group, MCV1 coverage changed little (ARD = 1%, 95%CI: -17%, 18%), but timely MCV1 at 9 months (ARD = 18%, 95%CI: 7%, 28%) and MCV2 coverage (ARD = 17%, 95%CI: 1%, 34%) rose significantly, and wastage fell (ARD = -7%, 95%CI: -14%, -1%). By endline, 29% of 5-dose health workers opened vials ≥10 times monthly (none in control); caregivers in both intervention groups reported 11% fewer measles-related MOVs. A nationwide 5-dose switch was estimated to save 17% in procurement cost per fully vaccinated (two-dose) child. CONCLUSIONS: The combined 5-dose intervention improved MCV1 timeliness and MCV2 coverage and reduced wastage, addressing a key operational barrier and potentially supporting measles elimination in Ethiopia.

analysis.summary_en: This cluster-randomized trial in Ethiopia evaluated whether replacing 10-dose measles vaccine vials with 5-dose vials, combined with a flexible open-vial policy, could improve coverage and timeliness while reducing wastage. Over 15 months, 60 woredas were randomized to policy-only, 5-dose switch, or control arms. The 5-dose switch significantly increased timely first-dose vaccination at 9 months (ARD 18%, 95% CI 7–28%) and second-dose coverage (ARD 17%, 95% CI 1–34%), while reducing wastage (ARD -7%, 95% CI -14% to -1%). Policy-only showed no significant differences versus control. A nationwide 5-dose switch was projected to cut procurement costs by 17% per fully vaccinated child. The study concludes that the combined intervention addresses operational barriers to measles elimination, though long-term effects and population-level impact remain unassessed.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:2024 年,全球估计有 95,000 人死于 麻疹,主要是由于含有 麻疹 的 疫苗 (MCV) 的覆盖范围不理想。卫生工作者可能会推迟为符合条件的儿童接种疫苗,以避免浪费 10 剂 MCV 小瓶中的剂量,这些小瓶必须在打开后六小时内丢弃。疫苗接种 (MOV) 错失的这些机会降低了覆盖范围和及时性。埃塞俄比亚在 9 个月和 15 个月时提供 MCV,考虑改用 5 剂小瓶。方法:我们在埃塞俄比亚进行了一项为期 15 个月的嵌套横断面设计随机对照试验。60 名被随机分配到:(1) 仅限政策,指示卫生工作者为任意数量的符合条件的儿童打开 10 剂小瓶,并增加库存以防止浪费;(2)5剂转换,将本政策与10剂瓶更换为5剂瓶相结合;(3) 对照(常规 10 剂练习)。基线和终点的家庭和卫生机构调查评估了对第一剂 (MCV1) 和第二剂 (MCV2) 覆盖率、MCV1 及时性和浪费的影响。广义估计方程模型估计了净干预效应与控制的关系。我们还估算了全国范围内更换 5 剂疫苗的政府成本。结果:纯政策和对照之间的 MCV1 覆盖率相似(调整后风险差 [ARD] = -1%,95%CI:-17%,15%),MCV1 及时性或 MCV2 覆盖率没有显着差异。在 5 剂转换组中,MCV1 覆盖率变化不大(ARD = 1%、95%CI:-17%、18%),但 9 个月时及时 MCV1(ARD = 18%、95%CI:7%、28%)和 MCV2 覆盖率(ARD = 17%、95%CI:1%、34%)显着上升,且损耗下降(ARD = -7%、 95%CI:-14%,-1%)。截至终点,29% 的 5 剂卫生工作者每月打开药瓶 ≥10 次(无对照);两个干预组的护理人员报告与 麻疹 相关的 MOV 减少了 11%。据估计,全国范围内更换 5 剂疫苗可为每个完全接种疫苗(两剂)的儿童节省 17% 的采购成本。结论:联合 5 剂干预措施提高了 MCV1 的及时性和 MCV2 的覆盖率,并减少了浪费,解决了关键的操作障碍,并可能支持埃塞俄比亚消除 麻疹。

papers.title: Analysis of measles outbreaks reported to Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP), India, 2019–2023
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: In 2022, an estimated 1,36,000 measles deaths were reported worldwide, mostly in children under five. In 2022, thirty-seven countries reported extensive or disruptive measles outbreaks by the WHO, while only 22 countries reported similar outbreaks in 2021. The NFHS-5, 87.9% of children between 12 and 23 months old had received their initial dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV), but only 31.9% of children aged 24-35 months who received MCV2. To perform descriptive epidemiology of measles outbreaks reported in India from 2019 to 2023. Methodology : A cross-sectional study was conducted utilisj ing the Integrated Disease Surveillance Program (IDSP). Measles outbreak data from 2019-2023. We extracted data from publicly available IDSP weekly outbreak reports and analysed them using MS Excel, focusing on time, place, and person distribution. Results : Out of 259 reported outbreaks, 89 % were laboratory-confirmed, and 56.3% of outbreaks were timely, with reporting occurring in the same week. Age distribution was not available in 56.4% of IDSP outbreak reports. The median (Interquartile range) age was 6.5 (5-9.5). Sex distribution was not available in 96% of IDSP outbreak reports. The 52.8% (137/259) outbreaks were reported from Bihar (18.5%), Jharkhand (13.5%), Uttar Pradesh (11.1%), and Gujarat (9.6%). The 25 districts have reported three or more measles outbreaks over five years. These districts account for 117 out of a total of 259 reported outbreaks: Godda (Jharkhand), West Champaran (Bihar), and Nuh (Haryana). The maximum number of outbreaks (116) was recorded in 2023. Vitamin A was given during 56% (114/259) of outbreaks. Twenty deaths were reported. Conclusions: Nearly half of the outbreaks were concentrated in five states of India. The delayed reporting of outbreaks and the absence of age and sex distribution in most reports highlight areas for improvement. Recommendations include timely reporting, inclusion of age and sex data, and ensuring widespread vitamin A supplementation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹 仍然是全球儿童 死亡率 的主要原因,预计 2022 年将有 136,000 人死亡,其中主要是五岁以下儿童。尽管在印度,含有 麻疹 的 疫苗 (MCV) 初始覆盖率很高,但只有少数儿童接受第二剂,从而使人群容易感染 暴发。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用综合疾病 监测 计划 (IDSP) 进行了一项横断面研究,对 2019 年至 2023 年印度报告的 麻疹 暴发 进行描述性 流行病学。数据从公开的 IDSP 每周 暴发 报告中提取,并使用 MS Excel 进行分析。
elements_zh.methods: 对 2019-2023 年 麻疹 暴发 数据进行分析,以评估时间、地点和人员分布。暴发 分为实验室确诊或临床怀疑,并根据发生周评估报告及时性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在报告的 259 例 暴发 中,89% 得到实验室确诊,56.3% 及时报告。病例的中位年龄为 6.5 岁(IQR 5-9.5)。百分之五十二点八的 暴发 发生在四个邦:比哈尔邦 (18.5%)、贾坎德邦 (13.5%)、北方邦 (11.1%) 和古吉拉特邦 (9.6%)。2023 年记录了 暴发 的最大数量(116 例)。在 56% 的 暴发 期间提供了维生素 A 补充剂,据报道有 20 人死亡。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,近一半的 暴发 集中在五个州,表明地理集群。大多数报告中的延迟报告和人口统计数据缺失凸显了 监测 质量和完整性方面的严重差距。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要及时进行 暴发 报告、在 死亡率 报告中纳入年龄和性别数据,并确保在 暴发 期间广泛补充维生素 A,以降低发病率和 死亡率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于,暴发 报告中分别有 56.4% 和 96% 的报告缺乏年龄和性别数据,这限制了详细的个人层面分析。由于依赖常规 监测 数据,可能存在漏报和不完整的变量,因此证据是中等的。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate why measles transmission risk reached epidemic thresholds in schools before the 2025–2026 outbreaks, highlighting the need to understand how surveillance systems might miss localized transmission patterns.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nationwide analysis of measles vaccination records from over 50,000 US schools was conducted to assess transmission risk, with the study period spanning 2–3 years prior to the 2025–2026 outbreaks.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed vaccination records to identify patterns of nonvaccination and used these data to estimate measles transmission risk at the school level, contrasting them with aggregated county-level estimates.
analysis.main_results: Measles transmission risk crossed the epidemic threshold at the school level 2–3 years before the 2025–2026 outbreaks, while county-level estimates consistently remained below that threshold.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that aggregated county-level data can obscure localized patterns of measles transmission risk, which is a novel empirical validation of the principle that fine-scale clustering of susceptibility sustains outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of refining surveillance systems to capture localized transmission risks, which could improve outbreak prediction and targeted public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on aggregated vaccination records and does not account for other factors influencing transmission, which may limit its generalizability. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on existing data rather than direct observation of transmission events.

analysis.summary_en: This study reveals that measles transmission risk reached epidemic thresholds in schools 2–3 years before the 2025–2026 outbreaks, while county-level estimates remained below the threshold. The research highlights how aggregated data can obscure localized patterns of nonvaccination, which increase outbreak potential. By analyzing vaccination records across over 50,000 US schools, the study provides empirical evidence supporting the principle that fine-scale clustering of susceptibility sustains measles outbreaks. These findings underscore the need for improved surveillance systems that capture localized transmission risks, which could enhance outbreak prediction and inform targeted public health interventions. However, the study's reliance on existing data rather than direct observation of transmission events limits its generalizability, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

papers.title: Determinants of post-campaign measles vaccination coverage in Madagascar: A geographically stratified analysis
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant cause of childhood mortality globally. Despite effective vaccines, the World Health Organisation reported an estimated 10.3 million measles cases worldwide in 2023, a 20% increase from 2022, primarily due to insufficient vaccination coverage. Madagascar faced a major measles epidemic in 2018–2019, prompting vaccination efforts. A convergent parallel mixed-methods design was utilised, wherein quantitative household surveys and semi-structured qualitative interviews were conducted concurrently. Data were integrated during the interpretation phase to triangulate statistical determinants with contextual stakeholder insights regarding the performance of the October 2024 measles vaccination campaign and its determinants across different geographical areas. This retrospective, cross-sectional Post-Measles Campaign Evaluation (PMCE) was conducted from December 2024 to April 2025, following the October 2024 campaign. It involved quantitative household surveys and qualitative interviews in all 23 regions of Madagascar, targeting children aged 9–59 months and their caregivers. A two-stage stratified random sampling approach distinguished large cities, landlocked, and intermediate districts. Multivariate logistic regressions were performed to identify geographical, socio-demographic, economic, and cultural determinants of post-campaign vaccination coverage. The study revealed a national post-campaign vaccination coverage of 75.3% in 2024, a notable 10-point increase from 65.3% in 2022. However, significant geographical disparities persisted (p-value = 0.0233), with lower coverage in large cities (63.2%) compared to landlocked (78.4%) and intermediate (76.2%) districts. Multivariate analysis showed that residing in a large city significantly reduced post-campaign vaccination coverage (OR adjusted = 0.25; p = 0.010). analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles remains a leading cause of childhood mortality globally, with WHO reporting an estimated 10.3 million cases in 2023, a 20% increase from 2022, largely due to suboptimal vaccination coverage. Madagascar experienced a major measles epidemic in 2018–2019, prompting intensified vaccination campaigns.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective, cross-sectional Post-Measles Campaign Evaluation (PMCE) was conducted from December 2024 to April 2025 in all 23 regions of Madagascar, following the October 2024 measles vaccination campaign. It employed a two-stage stratified random sampling approach distinguishing large cities, landlocked, and intermediate districts, targeting children aged 9–59 months and their caregivers.
analysis.methods: A convergent parallel mixed-methods design integrated quantitative household surveys with semi-structured qualitative interviews, analyzed using multivariate logistic regressions to identify geographical, socio-demographic, economic, and cultural determinants of post-campaign vaccination coverage.
analysis.main_results: The study reported a national post-campaign vaccination coverage of 75.3% in 2024, a 10-point increase from 65.3% in 2022. Significant geographical disparities persisted (p = 0.0233), with lower coverage in large cities (63.2%) compared to landlocked (78.4%) and intermediate (76.2%) districts. Residing in a large city significantly reduced coverage (OR adjusted = 0.25; p = 0.010), while male child gender (OR adjusted = 1.33; p = 0.040), birth in a health facility (OR adjusted = 1.38; p = 0.046), and possession of a birth certificate (OR adjusted = 2.30; p < 0.001) were associated with higher coverage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as indicating that urban residence is a major barrier to post-campaign measles vaccination coverage in Madagascar, while institutional birth and documentation status facilitate uptake. The study highlights the need for geographically tailored strategies to address persistent disparities.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform targeted vaccination strategies in urban areas and underscore the importance of health facility births and birth certification for improving coverage. They also provide evidence for refining future measles campaign planning in Madagascar.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and reliance on caregiver-reported vaccination status may introduce recall bias. Despite these limitations, the geographically stratified sampling and multivariate adjustment strengthen the evidence base for identifying key determinants.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated determinants of post-campaign measles vaccination coverage in Madagascar following the October 2024 campaign. Using a retrospective, cross-sectional design with stratified sampling across all 23 regions, it surveyed children aged 9–59 months and caregivers from December 2024 to April 2025. A convergent mixed-methods approach integrated quantitative surveys and qualitative interviews, analyzed via multivariate logistic regression. The national coverage reached 75.3%, a 10-point increase from 2022, but disparities persisted, with urban areas showing significantly lower coverage (63.2%) than landlocked (78.4%) or intermediate districts (76.2%). Urban residence reduced coverage odds (OR 0.25), while male gender, health facility birth, and birth certificate possession increased coverage. The authors attribute these patterns to contextual barriers in urban settings and facilitators linked to institutional access. Findings support targeted urban interventions and emphasize the role of health system engagement and documentation in improving vaccination uptake.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Measles remains a leading cause of childhood mortality globally, with WHO reporting an estimated 10.3 million cases in 2023, a 20% increase from 2022, largely due to suboptimal vaccination coverage. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 继 2024 年 10 月的 麻疹 疫苗接种 活动之后,这项回顾性、横断面的 麻疹 活动后评估 (PMCE) 于 2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 4 月在马达加斯加的所有 23 个地区进行。它采用两阶段分层随机抽样方法,区分大城市、内陆地区和中间地区,针对 9-59 个月的儿童及其照顾者。
elements_zh.methods: 收敛并行混合方法设计将定量家庭调查与半结构化定性访谈相结合,使用多元逻辑回归进行分析,以确定活动后 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的地理、社会人口、经济和文化决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,2024 年全国 疫苗接种 覆盖率达到 75.3%,比 2022 年的 65.3% 提高了 10 个百分点。显着的地理差异仍然存在 (p = 0.0233),大城市 (63.2%) 的覆盖率低于内陆地区 (78.4%) 和中等地区 (76.2%)。居住在大城市显着降低覆盖率(OR 调整 = 0.25;p = 0.010),而男孩性别(OR 调整 = 1.33;p = 0.040)、在医疗机构出生(OR 调整 = 1.38;p = 0.046)和拥有出生证明(OR 调整 = 2.30;p < 0.001)与较高的覆盖率相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解读为,城市居住是马达加斯加活动后 麻疹 疫苗接种 报道的主要障碍,而机构出生和证件状况则有助于采用。该研究强调需要制定针对地域的战略来解决持续存在的差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为城市地区的针对性 疫苗接种 战略提供了信息,并强调了医疗机构出生和出生证明对于提高覆盖率的重要性。它们还为完善马达加斯加未来的 麻疹 活动规划提供了证据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横断面设计限制了因果推断,并且依赖护理人员报告的 疫苗接种 状态可能会引入回忆偏差。尽管存在这些限制,地理分层抽样和多变量调整增强了确定关键决定因素的证据基础。

papers.title: Measles pneumonia, pneumomediastinum, pneumothorax, and pneumopericardium in an infant: a rare association in an epidemic context
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Measles is a highly contagious viral infection that most often affects unvaccinated children. The most frequent manifestation is respiratory involvement, which can progress to severe forms such as measles pneumonia. Air leak syndrome, comprising pneumomediastinum, pneumothorax, and pneumopericardium, is an exceptional and life-threatening complication that can precipitate respiratory failure. Case presentation We report the case of a five-month-old infant with measles pneumonia, further complicated by an Air leak syndrome consisting of pneumomediastinum, pneumothorax, and pneumopericardium. The association of measles pneumonia on the one hand and pneumothorax, pneumomediastinum, and pneumopericardium on the other is exceedingly rare, with only a limited number of similar cases described in the literature. Despite appropriate respiratory support, the infant died after forty-eight hours. Conclusion Through this case, we revisit the underlying pathophysiology of measles pneumonia and air leak syndrome, the diagnostic approach, and the various therapeutic options. This case report highlights the importance of early recognition of Air leak syndrome and the central role of vaccination in preventing this serious disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 麻疹 是一种高度传染性的病毒感染,最常影响未接种疫苗的儿童。最常见的表现是呼吸系统受累,可进展为 麻疹 肺炎等严重形式。漏气综合征包括纵隔气肿、气胸和心包积气,是一种特殊且危及生命的并发症,可导致呼吸衰竭。病例介绍 我们报告一例患有 麻疹 肺炎的 5 个月大婴儿,进一步并发漏气综合征,包括纵隔气肿、气胸和心包积气。一方面,麻疹 肺炎与气胸、纵隔积气和心包积气的关联极为罕见,文献中描述的类似病例数量有限。尽管有适当的呼吸支持,婴儿还是在四十八小时后死亡。结论 通过此病例,我们重新审视了 麻疹 肺炎漏气综合征的基本病理生理学、诊断方法和各种治疗方案。病例报告 强调了早期识别漏气综合症的重要性以及 病例报告 在预防这种严重疾病方面的核心作用。

papers.title: [Asylum seekers at the reception centre "Oldentruper Hof" Bielefeld: First measles vaccination dose rate of 90.3% after vaccination offer as part of the first medical assessment].
papers.abstract: AIM: The aim of this study is to identify demographic data, the "first measles vaccination dose rate after vaccination offer as part of the first medical assessment" (EMID rate) and barriers to measles vaccination among asylum seekers in the reception centre "Oldentruper Hof" Bielefeld (EAE OTH) in 2024. METHODOLOGY: This study is a retrospective data analysis. Demographic data and vaccination data are taken from the administrative Excel sheets and the vaccination lists of the EAE OTH. RESULTS: Data from 3213 asylum seekers in the EAE OTH were analysed for the year 2024. Most were young and male. The ten most frequent countries of origin in descending order were: Syria, Afghanistan, Turkey, Iraq, Iran, Serbia, (North) Macedonia, China, Algeria and both Angola und Azerbaijan (there were as many asylum seekers from Angola as from Azerbaijan). 3047 of them were of an age at which they needed to be immunised against measles. 6.3% of the 3047 were able to present a measles immunisation document from outside the EAE OTH. 84.0% of the 3047 had no external proof of measles immunisation and received their first measles vaccination dose in the EAE OTH. The EMID rate was therefore 90.3%. 9.7% had neither an external measles vaccination certificate nor did they receive their first measles vaccination dose at the EAE OTH. The following reasons were identified for this non-vaccination: Refusal by 1.5%, illness by 1.2%, pregnancy by 2.6%, 'other' by 4.3%. CONCLUSION: Overall, the EMID rate of the EAE OTH in 2024 was found to be high at 90.3%. Efforts must continue to further optimise this vaccination rate. Further studies in the different asylum reception centres and beyond are needed to obtain more research data on asylum seekers in Germany.
papers.journal: Gesundheitswesen (Bundesverband der Arzte des Offentlichen Gesundheitsdienstes (Germany))

papers.source_body_en: AIM: The aim of this study is to identify demographic data, the "first measles vaccination dose rate after vaccination offer as part of the first medical assessment" (EMID rate) and barriers to measles vaccination among asylum seekers in the reception centre "Oldentruper Hof" Bielefeld (EAE OTH) in 2024. METHODOLOGY: This study is a retrospective data analysis. Demographic data and vaccination data are taken from the administrative Excel sheets and the vaccination lists of the EAE OTH. RESULTS: Data from 3213 asylum seekers in the EAE OTH were analysed for the year 2024. Most were young and male. The ten most frequent countries of origin in descending order were: Syria, Afghanistan, Turkey, Iraq, Iran, Serbia, (North) Macedonia, China, Algeria and both Angola und Azerbaijan (there were as many asylum seekers from Angola as from Azerbaijan). 3047 of them were of an age at which they needed to be immunised against measles. 6.3% of the 3047 were able to present a measles immunisation document from outside the EAE OTH. 84.0% of the 3047 had no external proof of measles immunisation and received their first measles vaccination dose in the EAE OTH. The EMID rate was therefore 90.3%. 9.7% had neither an external measles vaccination certificate nor did they receive their first measles vaccination dose at the EAE OTH. The following reasons were identified for this non-vaccination: Refusal by 1.5%, illness by 1.2%, pregnancy by 2.6%, 'other' by 4.3%. CONCLUSION: Overall, the EMID rate of the EAE OTH in 2024 was found to be high at 90.3%. Efforts must continue to further optimise this vaccination rate. Further studies in the different asylum reception centres and beyond are needed to obtain more research data on asylum seekers in Germany.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:本研究的目的是确定人口数据、“作为第一次医疗评估一部分的 麻疹 疫苗接种 剂量率”(EMID 率)以及 2024 年比勒菲尔德“Oldentruper Hof”接待中心(EAE OTH)寻求庇护者中 麻疹 疫苗接种 的障碍。方法:本研究是一项回顾性数据分析。人口统计数据和 疫苗接种 数据取自 EAE OTH 的管理 Excel 工作表和 疫苗接种 列表。结果:对 2024 年 EAE OTH 3213 名寻求庇护者的数据进行了分析。大多数是年轻人和男性。按降序排列,最常见的十个原籍国是:叙利亚、阿富汗、土耳其、伊拉克、伊朗、塞尔维亚、(北)马其顿、中国、阿尔及利亚以及安哥拉和阿塞拜疆(来自安哥拉的寻求庇护者与来自阿塞拜疆的寻求庇护者一样多)。其中3047人达到了需要接种麻疹的年龄。3047 人中的 6.3% 能够出示来自 EAE OTH 之外的 麻疹 免疫文件。3047 人中的 84.0% 没有 麻疹 免疫的外部证据,并在 EAE OTH 中接受了第一剂 麻疹 疫苗接种。因此 EMID 率为 90.3%。9.7% 既没有外部 麻疹 麻疹 证书,也没有在 EAE OTH 接受第一剂 麻疹 疫苗接种 剂量。该非 疫苗接种 的原因如下:拒绝 1.5%、疾病 1.2%、怀孕 2.6%、“其他”4.3%。结论:总体而言,2024 年 EAE OTH 的 EMID 率高达 90.3%。必须继续努力进一步优化这个疫苗接种速率。需要在不同的庇护接收中心及其他地方进行进一步的研究,以获得更多关于德国寻求庇护者的研究数据。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap: Measles Susceptibility and Neutralization Test-Confirmed Immunity in a Spanish HIV-PrEP Cohort
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Measles is re-emerging in highly vaccinated settings, where small gaps in adult immunity may persist. Standard IgG assays are widely used to assess measles immunity, but negative or borderline results may not reflect absence of functional protection. HIV pre-exposureprophylaxis (HIV-PrEP) programs provide regular preventive-care contact and may offer an opportunity to review adult measles immunity. We assessed measles immunity in a Spanish HIVPrEP cohort using chemiluminescence immunoassay (ChLIA) and neutralization testing (NT). Methods We performed a cross-sectional analysis of 155 participants enrolled in a prospective HIV-PrEP cohort in Córdoba, Spain. Measles-specific IgG was measured by ChLIA. All ChLIA -negative or borderline samples, together with 30 randomly selected ChLIA -positive samples, underwent NT. Confirmed susceptibility was defined as ChLIA -negative/borderline and NT-negative. Results Among participants, 149 (96.1%) were male and the median age was 37 years. ChLIA classified 125 participants (80.6%) as IgG-positive, 27 (17.4%) as negative, and 3 (1.9%) as borderline. Among 30 ChLIA -negative/borderline samples, 23 (76.7%) were NT-positive and 7 (23.3%) NT-negative. All 30 randomly selected ChLIA-positive samples were NT-positive. Overall, 7 participants (4.5%) lacked confirmed measles immunity. All were Spanish-born men aged 26–39 years, and 4 had documented two-dose measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination completed at least 20 years before inclusion. Conclusions Confirmed measles susceptibility was uncommon in this HIV-PrEP cohort. Most participants with negative or borderline ChLIA results retained neutralizing antibodies, indicating that isolated ChLIA findings may overestimate susceptibility. Routine adult preventive-care encounters may provide opportunities to review measles immunity documentation.

papers.title_zh: 缩小差距:麻疹 西班牙 HIV-PrEP 麻疹 的易感性和中和试验证实具有免疫力 队列研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Measles is re-emerging in highly vaccinated settings, where small gaps in adult immunity may persist. Standard IgG assays are widely used to assess measles immunity, but negative or borderline results may not reflect absence of functional protection. HIV pre-exposureprophylaxis (HIV-PrEP) programs provide regular preventive-care contact and may offer an opportunity to review adult measles immunity. We assessed measles immunity in a Spanish HIVPrEP cohort using chemiluminescence immunoassay (ChLIA) and neutralization testing (NT). Methods We performed a cross-sectional analysis of 155 participants enrolled in a prospective HIV-PrEP cohort in Córdoba, Spain. Measles-specific IgG was measured by ChLIA. All ChLIA -negative or borderline samples, together with 30 randomly selected ChLIA -positive samples, underwent NT. Confirmed susceptibility was defined as ChLIA -negative/borderline and NT-negative. Results Among participants, 149 (96.1%) were male and the median age was 37 years. ChLIA classified 125 participants (80.6%) as IgG-positive, 27 (17.4%) as negative, and 3 (1.9%) as borderline. Among 30 ChLIA -negative/borderline samples, 23 (76.7%) were NT-positive and 7 (23.3%) NT-negative. All 30 randomly selected ChLIA-positive samples were NT-positive. Overall, 7 participants (4.5%) lacked confirmed measles immunity. All were Spanish-born men aged 26–39 years, and 4 had documented two-dose measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination completed at least 20 years before inclusion. Conclusions Confirmed measles susceptibility was uncommon in this HIV-PrEP cohort. Most participants with negative or borderline ChLIA results retained neutralizing antibodies, indicating that isolated ChLIA findings may overestimate susceptibility. Routine adult preventive-care encounters may provide opportunities to review measles immunity documentation.

papers.title: Investigating the Risk Factor of Measles (A Case Study of Sir Yahaya Memorial Hospital, Birnin Kebbi, Kebbi State, Nigeria)
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health concern in Nigeria, particularly in regions with limited healthcare infrastructure, especially in North Western Nigeria. Therefore, this study investigated the risk factors linked to Measles in Sir Yahaya Memorial Hospital, Birnin Kebbi, Kebbi State. A total of 108 confirmed cases were selected, finding that 70 were active (64.8%) and 38 inactive 35.2% for the measles outcome. Both respondents, males and females each accounted for 54 cases (50.0%). Most respondents (66.7%) were not vaccinated and (33.3%) were vaccinated. Binary Logistic Regression was used for the analysis. The results revealed that Vaccination Status acts as a powerful protective factor, indicated by a strong negative coefficient (B = -2.87, p < 0.001). Clinical Symptoms: Both rash (B = 3.45, p < 0.001) and cough (B = 1.36, p = 0.019) significantly increase the likelihood of a positive measles diagnosis. Fever shows high joint significance (Wald = 18.62, p < 0.001), with higher fever levels consistently raising the probability of infection. Age, displays a modest but statistically significant positive correlation (B = 0.07, p = 0.020), where risk slightly rises with age. However, Sex was found to be statistically insignificant, suggesting that it is not a risk factors for measles. Also, demographic variables like gender plays a negligible role. The model fitting criteria showed a significant improvement in predicting measles, with the final model having a lower Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) of 24.970 and a Chi-Square statistic of 68.619 (p-value = 0.000), indicating a strong fit. The findings highlighted the need for targeted healthcare programmes and policies in Kebbi State, providing valuable insights for global measles research and emphasizing the importance of community-specific strategies to lessen the burden of breast cancer.

papers.title_zh: 调查 麻疹 的危险因素(以尼日利亚凯比州 Birnin Kebbi Yahaya 爵士纪念医院为例)
papers.source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health concern in Nigeria, particularly in regions with limited healthcare infrastructure, especially in North Western Nigeria. Therefore, this study investigated the risk factors linked to Measles in Sir Yahaya Memorial Hospital, Birnin Kebbi, Kebbi State. A total of 108 confirmed cases were selected, finding that 70 were active (64.8%) and 38 inactive 35.2% for the measles outcome. Both respondents, males and females each accounted for 54 cases (50.0%). Most respondents (66.7%) were not vaccinated and (33.3%) were vaccinated. Binary Logistic Regression was used for the analysis. The results revealed that Vaccination Status acts as a powerful protective factor, indicated by a strong negative coefficient (B = -2.87, p < 0.001). Clinical Symptoms: Both rash (B = 3.45, p < 0.001) and cough (B = 1.36, p = 0.019) significantly increase the likelihood of a positive measles diagnosis. Fever shows high joint significance (Wald = 18.62, p < 0.001), with higher fever levels consistently raising the probability of infection. Age, displays a modest but statistically significant positive correlation (B = 0.07, p = 0.020), where risk slightly rises with age. However, Sex was found to be statistically insignificant, suggesting that it is not a risk factors for measles. Also, demographic variables like gender plays a negligible role. The model fitting criteria showed a significant improvement in predicting measles, with the final model having a lower Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) of 24.970 and a Chi-Square statistic of 68.619 (p-value = 0.000), indicating a strong fit. The findings highlighted the need for targeted healthcare programmes and policies in Kebbi State, providing valuable insights for global measles research and emphasizing the importance of community-specific strategies to lessen the burden of breast cancer.
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹 仍然是尼日利亚的一个重大公共卫生问题,特别是在医疗基础设施有限的地区,特别是在尼日利亚西北部。因此,本研究调查了凯比州伯宁凯比 Yahaya 爵士纪念医院与 麻疹 相关的危险因素。总共选择了 108 例确诊病例,发现 麻疹 结果中 70 例处于活动状态(64.8%),38 例处于非活动状态,占 35.2%。受访者中男性和女性各占 54 例(50.0%)。大多数受访者(66.7%)没有接种疫苗,(33.3%)接种了疫苗。使用二元逻辑回归进行分析。结果表明,疫苗接种 状态是一个强大的保护因素,表现为很强的负系数(B = -2.87,p < 0.001)。临床症状:皮疹(B = 3.45,p < 0.001)和咳嗽(B = 1.36,p = 0.019)均显着增加 麻疹 诊断 阳性的可能性。发烧表现出较高的联合显着性(Wald = 18.62,p < 0.001),较高的发烧水平始终会增加感染的可能性。年龄显示出适度但具有统计显着性的正相关性(B = 0.07,p = 0.020),其中风险随着年龄的增长而略有上升。然而,性别被发现在统计上不显着,表明它不是 麻疹 的危险因素。此外,性别等人口统计变量的作用可以忽略不计。模型拟合标准显示在预测 麻疹 方面有显着改进,最终模型的 Akaike 信息标准 (AIC) 较低,为 24.970,卡方统计量为 68.619(p 值 = 0.000),表明拟合度很高。研究结果强调了凯比州有针对性的医疗保健计划和政策的必要性,为全球 麻疹 研究提供了宝贵的见解,并强调了针对减轻乳腺癌负担的社区特定策略的重要性。

papers.title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
papers.abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了孟加拉国对2026年麻疹 暴发的公共卫生应对措施,重点关注政府对危机的管理。
elements_zh.methods: 卫生专业人员和 麻疹 专家将 麻疹 归因于常规免疫积累的差距、公共卫生基础设施薄弱、儿童营养状况不佳、维生素 A 普遍缺乏以及孕产妇在怀孕和哺乳期间营养不良。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究确定了常规免疫接种中累积的差距、公共卫生基础设施的薄弱、儿童营养状况不佳、维生素 A 普遍缺乏以及孕产妇在怀孕和母乳喂养期间营养不良是导致 暴发 的因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 麻疹 解释为免疫和公共卫生基础设施系统性失败的结果,强调了孟加拉国背景下营养缺乏和 麻疹 脆弱性的新交叉。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于专家归因,没有主要数据收集或统计分析,限制了因果推断。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe epidemiological characteristics of suspected measles cases in the Central region of Vietnam during 2024–2025, addressing a public-health need to monitor a rising burden of febrile rash illness potentially attributable to measles.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cross-sectional descriptive study analyzed 20,975 suspected measles cases reported from 11 provinces/cities in Central Vietnam between January 2024 and June 2025.
analysis.methods: Data were extracted from standardized measles/rubella case investigation forms issued by Vietnam’s Ministry of Health under Decision 4845/QĐ-BYT dated 05/12/2012.
analysis.main_results: Suspected measles cases rose sharply from September 2024, peaking in March 2025 with 4,823 cases; southern provinces (Khanh Hoa, Ninh Thuan, Binh Thuan) peaked earlier than others, and Da Nang reported the highest incidence at 6,135 cases (480.8 per 100,000 population).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the shift toward older age groups (mean age 10.4 years; 1–30 years accounting for 12.5%) as a changing epidemiological pattern of measles in the region, highlighting the need for targeted control measures.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform surveillance priorities and outbreak response strategies in Central Vietnam, particularly for older age cohorts where immunity gaps may exist.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s retrospective design and reliance on surveillance data limit causal inference and generalizability; evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential underreporting and incomplete laboratory confirmation.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cross-sectional study in Central Vietnam analyzed 20,975 suspected measles cases from January 2024 to June 2025, using standardized national case investigation forms. Suspected cases surged from September 2024, peaking in March 2025 with 4,823 cases; southern provinces peaked earlier, and Da Nang reported the highest incidence at 480.8 per 100,000 population. The mean patient age was 10.4 years, with 12.5% aged 1–30 years, indicating a shift toward older age groups. The authors interpret this as a changing epidemiological pattern requiring targeted control measures. These findings guide surveillance and outbreak response, particularly for older cohorts where immunity gaps may exist. The study’s retrospective design and reliance on surveillance data limit causal inference and generalizability, warranting moderate confidence.

papers.title: Measles virus reprograms CD4+ T-cell sphingolipid and fatty acid metabolism to facilitate infection
papers.abstract: Introduction CD150-positive (CD150 + ) lymphocytes are the primary targets of measles virus (MV) infection during the acute phase. The depletion of infected CD150 + memory cells leads to a profound suppression of immune memory, resulting in increased susceptibility to secondary infections and severe complications in infected individuals. While lipids are known to be critical for viral life cycles, the specific lipid metabolic conditions facilitating MV replication in immune cells remain poorly understood. Methods and Results In this study, a comprehensive lipidomic analysis of MV-infected primary CD4 + T cells revealed significant alterations in three major lipid classes: sphingolipids, triacylglycerols, and glycerophospholipids. Specifically, MV infection increased the abundance of ceramides, dihydroceramides and triacylglycerols, while significantly reducing the levels of glucosylceramides and glycerophospholipids. Pharmacological intervention in the pathways of de novo sphingolipid synthesis, triacylglycerol synthesis and lipolysis significantly impaired measles virus replication in activated CD4 + CD150 + T cells. Discussion Mechanistically, we demonstrate that MV glycoprotein-mediated membrane fusion, essential for viral entry and cell-to-cell spread, requires glucosylceramide synthase (GCS) activity and is further promoted by plasma membrane triacylglycerol content. Collectively, these findings highlight the essential role of MV-modulated triacylglycerol and sphingolipid metabolism in viral entry, dissemination, and intracellular replication within CD4 + T cells.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology

papers.title_original: Measles virus reprograms CD4+ T-cell sphingolipid and fatty acid metabolism to facilitate infection

analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles virus (MV) infection of CD150-positive lymphocytes drives acute disease and long-term immune suppression, yet the specific lipid metabolic conditions enabling MV replication in immune cells were not defined. The study aimed to elucidate how MV reprograms host lipid metabolism to facilitate infection in CD4+ T cells.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study performed a comprehensive lipidomic analysis of MV-infected primary CD4+ T cells to identify lipid class alterations during infection. Primary activated CD4+ CD150+ T cells were used as the host system for infection and subsequent metabolic profiling.
analysis.methods: Lipidomic profiling quantified changes in sphingolipids, triacylglycerols, and glycerophospholipids in MV-infected CD4+ T cells. Pharmacological inhibitors targeting de novo sphingolipid synthesis, triacylglycerol synthesis, and lipolysis were applied to assess their impact on MV replication in activated CD4+ CD150+ T cells.
analysis.main_results: MV infection significantly increased ceramides, dihydroceramides, and triacylglycerols while reducing glucosylceramides and glycerophospholipids in CD4+ T cells. Pharmacological blockade of sphingolipid and triacylglycerol pathways impaired MV replication in activated CD4+ CD150+ T cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors demonstrate that MV glycoprotein-mediated membrane fusion requires glucosylceramide synthase activity and is promoted by plasma membrane triacylglycerol content, revealing a mechanistic link between MV-modulated lipid metabolism and viral entry, dissemination, and replication.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that targeting host lipid metabolic pathways, particularly sphingolipid and triacylglycerol synthesis, could represent a therapeutic strategy to impair MV replication and mitigate measles-associated immune suppression.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on in vitro infection of primary CD4+ T cells and does not evaluate lipidomic changes in vivo or in clinical samples, limiting generalisability to natural infection. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of animal model validation and limited sample diversity.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how measles virus (MV) reprograms lipid metabolism in CD4+ T cells to facilitate infection. Using lipidomic profiling of MV-infected primary CD4+ T cells, the authors found that MV infection significantly increased ceramides, dihydroceramides, and triacylglycerols while reducing glucosylceramides and glycerophospholipids. Pharmacological inhibition of sphingolipid and triacylglycerol pathways impaired MV replication in activated CD4+ CD150+ T cells. Mechanistically, MV glycoprotein-mediated membrane fusion required glucosylceramide synthase activity and was promoted by plasma membrane triacylglycerol content, highlighting a novel dependency of MV on host lipid metabolism for entry, dissemination, and replication. These findings suggest potential therapeutic targets to disrupt MV infection and mitigate measles-associated immune suppression, though the study’s in vitro design and lack of in vivo validation limit direct clinical applicability.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹病毒 重新编程 CD4+ T 细胞鞘脂和脂肪酸代谢以促进感染
papers.source_body_en: Introduction CD150-positive (CD150 + ) lymphocytes are the primary targets of measles virus (MV) infection during the acute phase. The depletion of infected CD150 + memory cells leads to a profound suppression of immune memory, resulting in increased susceptibility to secondary infections and severe complications in infected individuals. While lipids are known to be critical for viral life cycles, the specific lipid metabolic conditions facilitating MV replication in immune cells remain poorly understood. Methods and Results In this study, a comprehensive lipidomic analysis of MV-infected primary CD4 + T cells revealed significant alterations in three major lipid classes: sphingolipids, triacylglycerols, and glycerophospholipids. Specifically, MV infection increased the abundance of ceramides, dihydroceramides and triacylglycerols, while significantly reducing the levels of glucosylceramides and glycerophospholipids. Pharmacological intervention in the pathways of de novo sphingolipid synthesis, triacylglycerol synthesis and lipolysis significantly impaired measles virus replication in activated CD4 + CD150 + T cells. Discussion Mechanistically, we demonstrate that MV glycoprotein-mediated membrane fusion, essential for viral entry and cell-to-cell spread, requires glucosylceramide synthase (GCS) activity and is further promoted by plasma membrane triacylglycerol content. Collectively, these findings highlight the essential role of MV-modulated triacylglycerol and sphingolipid metabolism in viral entry, dissemination, and intracellular replication within CD4 + T cells.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介 CD150 阳性 (CD150 + ) 淋巴细胞是 麻疹病毒 (MV) 急性期感染的主要目标。受感染的 CD150 + 记忆细胞的耗竭会导致免疫记忆的严重抑制,导致受感染个体对继发感染和严重并发症的易感性增加。虽然已知脂质对于病毒生命周期至关重要,但促进免疫细胞中 MV 复制的特定脂质代谢条件仍知之甚少。方法和结果在这项研究中,对 MV 感染的原代 CD4 + T 细胞进行的全面脂质组学分析揭示了三种主要脂质类别的显着变化:鞘脂、三酰甘油和甘油磷脂。具体来说,MV感染增加了神经酰胺、二氢神经酰胺和三酰甘油的丰度,同时显着降低了葡萄糖神经酰胺和甘油磷脂的水平。对鞘脂从头合成、三酰甘油合成和脂肪分解途径的药物干预显着损害了活化的 CD4 + CD150 + T 细胞中的 麻疹病毒 复制。从机制上讲,我们证明MV糖蛋白介导的膜融合对于病毒进入和细胞间传播至关重要,需要葡萄糖神经酰胺合酶(GCS)活性,并通过质膜三酰甘油含量进一步促进。总的来说,这些发现强调了 MV 调节的三酰甘油和鞘脂代谢在 CD4 + T 细胞内的病毒进入、传播和细胞内复制中的重要作用。

papers.full_text: Background: Device stewardship is an important infection prevention opportunity for catheter-associated urinary tract infection reduction. This starts with the avoidance of initial catheter placement without defini- tive clinical need, especially with the option of alternative of non-invasive foley devices for both male and female anatomy. Urinary catheter place- ment in the Emergency Department (ED) is an area of opportunity where catheter placement could be avoided in favor of non-invasive management. This study assessed potential unnecessary catheter placement in a commu- nity hospital-based ED with a focus on ED-placed urinary catheters removed within 24 hours of admission. Methods: All patient encounters with an indwelling urinary catheter placed in 3 community hospital EDs from May 20, 2024 through September 29, 2025 were included. Encounters for patients who required chronic urinary catheterization (defined as the presence of a urinary catheter for ≥45 days) who had catheter replacement in the ED were excluded. The frequency of possible unnecessary catheter placement was defined as the number of catheters removed within 24 hours out of the total encounters. A subset of charts for encounters with a possible unnecessary catheter placed were reviewed to assess for commonalities to guide quality improvement. Results: During the study period, across all 3 facilities, 27.7% (385/1391) of urinary catheters placed in the ED were removed within 24 hours with a similar frequency at each individual facility (Hospital 1 = 24.6% (82/334), Hospital 2 = 24.9% (121/486), Hospital 3 = 31.9% (182/571)). The monthly frequency of possible unnec- essary catheter placement ranged between 12.5% to 48.4% (Figure 1). Based on chart review, several common themes were noted, including placement in patients with altered mental status without hemodynamic instability and in patients with brief transient hemodynamic instability weaned from low dose inotropic medications and ventilation within 24 hours of admission. A clinical decision-making tool was created targeting recurrent scenarios that might warrant catheter avoidance (Figure 2). Discussion: ED place- ment of urinary catheters that were quickly removed by clinical teams upon admission was common across 3 community-based hospitals, highlighting possible unnecessary placement upon evaluation by the inpatient teams. A proposed clinical decision tool was created to help guide physicians in the reasoning behind the perceived need for catheter placement in the ED ver- sus waiting to evaluate clinical need upon admission based upon patient course and failure of alternative methods for urine output management.
