papers.full_text: Background: Environmental hygiene (EH) plays a critical role in reducing healthcare-associated infection (HAI) risk, yet significant variability persists in hospital patient room cleaning and disinfection. While discharge cleaning compliance is frequently studied, real-world practices during daily occupied patient room cleaning remain poorly characterized. Furthermore, the time to complete Environmental Services (EVS) tasks is rarely reported in published literature, despite being linked to budget, facility throughput, and patient and employee satisfaction. Researchers conducted a multi-hospital, observational study about environmental cleaning processes. Methods: Across 3 large (<500 beds) teaching hospitals in 3 distinct US regions, researchers shadowed EVS technicians during daily and discharge patient room cleaning across diverse ward types. Direct practice observations documented total turnover time, time to complete tasks such as cleaning the patient and bathroom room surfaces, floor mopping and non-disinfection tasks using a standardized data collection tool (Figure 1). Cleaning compliance was also measured via visual assessment, defined as wiping a surface with a disinfectant wipe or cloth. Results: A total of 638 daily and 91 discharge cleans were evaluated. The average occupied daily room turnover time was 9 minutes. However, square footage, isolation needs, in-room equipment and EVS expectations varied across unit types and individual facilities. For daily occupied room cleaning, on average, more time was spent on non-disinfection tasks like removing waste, refilling consumables and patient engagement (see Table 1). High-touch surface (HTS) cleaning compliance during daily cleans was low (38–48%), whereas floor mopping occurred in <90% of rooms. Site Z spent approximately twice the average time performing a daily room clean compared to Sites X and Y, however, did not achieve greater than 50% HTS cleaning compliance. Discharge cleaning demonstrated markedly higher HTS compliance (87–92%) and longer average duration (Table 2). Conclusion: To date, EH research has been focused on cleaning compliance measured by fluorescent marking, ATP swabbing and/or environmental culturing. Less research, however, is available regarding daily occupied patient room cleaning and the time and resources needed to do it successfully. Our research revealed that EVS technicians across 3 large hospitals spent an average of 9 minutes on daily room cleaning and only a third of that time spent using a disinfectant. Many healthcare disinfectants used by EVS have a contact time of 5 minutes or more. Healthcare leadership should have realistic expectations of what can be accomplished in budgeted cleaning time and the impact of time on disinfectant efficacy, regulatory compliance and infection prevention.A form for observing and recording room cleaning activities in a healthcare setting. papers.title_original: 252 Developing a Measles Flagging System within the Electronic Health Record

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a measles flagging system within the electronic health record to improve surveillance and management of measles cases. The background highlights the critical role of environmental hygiene in reducing healthcare-associated infection risk, with a focus on the variability in cleaning practices.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was an observational, multi-hospital investigation conducted across 3 large teaching hospitals in 3 distinct US regions. Researchers shadowed Environmental Services (EVS) technicians during daily and discharge patient room cleaning across diverse ward types.
analysis.methods: Direct practice observations were used to document total turnover time and time spent on specific tasks such as cleaning patient and bathroom surfaces, floor mopping, and non-disinfection activities. Cleaning compliance was assessed via visual evaluation, defined as wiping a surface with a disinfectant wipe or cloth.
analysis.main_results: A total of 638 daily and 91 discharge cleans were evaluated. The average occupied daily room turnover time was 9 minutes, with only a third of that time dedicated to disinfectant use. High-touch surface (HTS) cleaning compliance during daily cleans was low (38–48%), whereas floor mopping occurred in <90% of rooms. Site Z spent approximately twice the average time performing a daily room clean but did not achieve greater than 50% HTS cleaning compliance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that current EH research has primarily focused on compliance measured by fluorescent marking, ATP swabbing, and environmental culturing, but less attention has been given to the time and resources required for daily occupied patient room cleaning. This study provides novel insights into the practical challenges of cleaning in real-world settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform healthcare leadership about realistic expectations for cleaning within budgeted time and the potential impact of time constraints on disinfectant efficacy, regulatory compliance, and infection prevention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is observational and relies on direct practice observations, which may introduce bias. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of randomized design and potential variability in technician performance across sites.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a measles flagging system within the electronic health record to improve measles surveillance and management. It conducted an observational investigation across three US teaching hospitals, shadowing Environmental Services (EVS) technicians during daily and discharge patient room cleaning. The researchers documented total turnover time and specific tasks, finding that the average daily room cleaning took 9 minutes, with only a third of that time spent on disinfectant use. High-touch surface (HTS) cleaning compliance was low (38–48%), while floor mopping was common (<90%). Site Z spent twice the average time on daily cleaning but still had low HTS compliance. The study highlights the need for realistic expectations about cleaning time and its impact on disinfectant efficacy and infection prevention. The findings suggest that current EH research has focused on compliance metrics but lacks attention to the practical challenges of daily cleaning. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational design and potential variability in technician performance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在在电子健康记录中开发 麻疹 标记系统,以改进 麻疹 和 麻疹 病例的管理。背景强调了环境卫生在降低医疗保健相关感染风险方面的关键作用,重点是清洁实践的变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项观察性多医院调查,在美国 3 个不同地区的 3 家大型教学医院中进行。研究人员在日常清洁过程中对环境服务 (EVS) 技术人员进行跟踪,并在不同类型的病房中出院进行病房清洁。
elements_zh.methods: 直接实践观察用于记录总周转时间和花在特定任务上的时间,例如清洁患者和浴室表面、拖地和非消毒活动。通过视觉评估来评估清洁依从性,定义为用消毒湿巾或布擦拭表面。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共评估了 638 次日常清洁和 91 次出院清洁。每天平均占用的房间周转时间为 9 分钟,其中只有三分之一的时间用于使用消毒剂。日常清洁期间的高接触表面 (HTS) 清洁依从性较低 (38-48%),而拖地的情况发生在 <90% 的房间中。站点 Z 花费大约两倍的平均时间进行日常房间清洁,但未达到超过 50% 的 HTS 清洁合规性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,目前的 EH 研究主要集中在通过荧光标记、ATP 拭子和环境培养测量的依从性上,但很少关注日常占用病房清洁所需的时间和资源。这项研究为现实环境中清洁的实际挑战提供了新颖的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以让医疗保健领导层了解在预算时间内清洁的现实期望,以及时间限制对消毒剂功效、法规遵从性和感染预防策略的潜在影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是观察性的,依赖于直接的实践观察,这可能会引入偏差。由于缺乏随机设计以及不同地点的技术人员表现存在潜在差异,证据强度中等。

papers.full_text: The World Health Organization estimates that in 2026 nearly 11 million people will contract the virus that causes measles. Most of these cases will occur in Africa and Asia, but many countries in the Americas and Europe are reporting outbreaks affecting hundreds or thousands of people. There is no treatment for measles, but vaccines have been proven to be safe and effective at preventing the disease. Unvaccinated people who get sick with measles are at risk of serious complications that can lead to deafness, blindness and death. The risk of a bad outcome is higher for people who are undernourished and unable to access supportive medical care. As an infectious disease epidemiologist, I study the reasons for changes in population health risks around the world. The specific factors leading to measles epidemics vary by country, but the underlying cause everywhere is decreased vaccination rates. Zero-dose children in low-income countries The vast majority of parents around the world want to protect their children from preventable infectious diseases through vaccination. In many lower-income countries, the supply of vaccines remains insufficient to meet the demand for them. Because measles is highly contagious, the vaccination rate needs to be above 95% to protect a community from outbreaks, creating what is known as “herd immunity.” One dose of measles vaccine protects most people from the disease, but two doses are recommended to improve effectiveness. Most high-income countries have measles vaccine rates near the 95% target. In Europe, the average one-dose vaccination rate is about 94%, and the two-dose rate is about 88%. In the U.S., more than 90% of 2-year-olds have received at least one dose of measles vaccine and more than 92% of kindergartners have received two doses. The vaccine coverage rate is above 95% in many communities, though it is much lower in some school districts. In contrast, only about 80% of young children in low- and middle-income countries have received at least one dose of measles vaccine, and only about 70% have received two doses. Almost every country had reduced access to vaccines during the early months of the COVID-19 pandemic, when supply chains and clinic access were severely disrupted. Most young children in high-income countries were able to catch up on missed doses before they reached school age. But in lower-income countries, millions of kids who missed routine vaccinations during the pandemic are still classified as “zero-dose children” who have not received any of the vaccines their countries recommend. Only a tiny fraction of the cases of measles diagnosed in lower-income countries are confirmed with laboratory tests and reported to public health authorities, so it’s impossible to get an exact case count. But healthcare workers have reported observing higher than typical numbers of cases in many countries during the past year. In 2026, measles epidemics have been reported in countries experiencing armed conflict or housing refugees displaced by war, such as Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Somalia, Sudan and Yemen. Outbreaks have also been reported in peaceful countries, including Maldives and Zambia, and cases are surging in India. Dozens of other countries are also experiencing epidemics. All of these situations are linked to undervaccination. Vaccine shortages in Bangladesh Bangladesh has reported more measles cases this year than any other country, and more than 900 people have died from the infection. While Bangladesh faces many of the same challenges as other low- and middle-income countries, the past few years have presented some unique difficulties. In 2024, the country’s longtime government collapsed and an interim government was installed. During this time of political instability the government ordered too few vaccine doses. In 2025 vaccine shortages worsened when the interim government decided to stop procuring its vaccines through UNICEF and instead tried to purchase them through a competitive bidding process before new supply chains had been established. Bangladesh has now resumed working with UNICEF to acquire vaccines. Unfortunately, it has returned to UNICEF at a time when its partner organization Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, is facing funding cuts. Under Gavi’s cofinancing model, low- and middle-income countries’ initial vaccine purchases are subsidized by contributions from high-income countries and other investors. Over time, countries pay an increasing portion of their own vaccine costs. Because Gavi pools orders from all over the world, it is able to shape markets and negotiate with vaccine manufacturers for lower costs per dose. The major limitation of this system is that reduced funding for global health shrinks the budget for subsidizing vaccine purchases. But since 2025, France, Germany, the U.K., the U.S. and several other high-income countries have significantly reduced their budgets for development assistance, leaving Gavi with a substantial budget shortfall. As Bangladesh has grown its economy, it is paying a greater share of the costs of the vaccines it purchases through Gavi. However, it does not yet have the means to fully self-finance its vaccine program. For now, if Gavi’s budget is not fully replenished, countries like Bangladesh will not have enough money to buy all of the vaccines they need. Even though a mass vaccination campaign in early 2026 saw more than 1 million Bangladeshi children vaccinated against measles, the percentage of children who have been vaccinated remains far below the 95% threshold required to prevent widespread epidemics. Vaccine hesitancy in faith communities in the Americas Two years ago the entire region of the Americas – North, Central, and South America and the Caribbean – was classified as a measles-free zone. Canada officially lost its measles elimination status in November 2025 after more than a year of sustained transmission. Mexico and the U.S. have met the criteria to lose their measles-free status when the Pan American Health Organization’s measles elimination committee meets again in November 2026. The country reporting the largest number of measles cases in the Americas in 2026 is Guatemala, which has already logged more than 30,000 confirmed cases. The Guatemalan epidemic has been traced back to a gathering in Santiago Atitlán in December 2025 that was organized by a Christian megachurch whose leaders have been vocal about their anti-vaccine views. Measles began circulating in late 2024 and early 2025 in Canada, Mexico and the U.S. among rural, conservative Mennonite communities where leaving children unvaccinated has become the cultural norm. In South Carolina and Utah, recent outbreaks have been linked to low vaccination rates among conservative religious groups that are not connected with Mennonite churches. More cases of measles have already been diagnosed in the U.S. in 2026 than in any year since 1991. The measles virus has moved from religious communities into other undervaccinated population groups. The epidemic that started in Mennonite villages in Mexico spread into neighboring Indigenous communities. An outbreak that started among German-speaking Mennonites in Bolivia crossed the border into Peru and was then amplified by visitors to large cultural festivals who brought the virus home with them. Stopping the spread The total number of measles cases per year decreased from an estimated 38 million in 2000 to about 10 million in 2019. That trend has reversed since the COVID-19 pandemic. The number of measles cases and the number of countries experiencing measles epidemics has gone up as the vaccination rate in some populations has gone down. Getting back on track toward eliminating measles as a global public health problem will look different depending on the circumstances in each country. For low- and middle-income countries, ending measles epidemics will require increasing funding for Gavi and other international partnerships so that the vaccine supply can grow to meet the demand. The need is different in countries where vaccination rates are falling even though measles vaccines are readily available. Stopping the spread of measles in undervaccinated communities will depend on the challenging task of building vaccine confidence among parents of young children.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the global public health concern of rising measles cases in 2026, highlighting the need to understand the factors contributing to this increase and the associated risks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a global epidemiological analysis conducted in 2026, examining measles cases across various regions, including Africa, Asia, the Americas, and Europe, with a focus on countries experiencing outbreaks and disparities in vaccination rates.
analysis.methods: The study uses global health data, including vaccination coverage rates, outbreak reports, and public health observations, to identify trends and factors influencing measles transmission and incidence.
analysis.main_results: The study found that measles epidemics in 2026 are linked to decreased vaccination rates, with specific cases reported in countries affected by conflict and in peaceful countries like the Maldives and Zambia. In Bangladesh, vaccine shortages and funding issues have contributed to a significant rise in measles cases and deaths.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the underlying cause of measles epidemics globally is the decline in vaccination rates, and they note that the situation varies by country due to differing circumstances and challenges.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of maintaining high vaccination rates to prevent outbreaks and highlight the need for targeted interventions in low-income countries and regions with political instability.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the lack of exact case counts in many lower-income countries, as only a small fraction of measles cases are confirmed through laboratory tests. The study provides a moderate assessment of the situation based on reported observations and public health data.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the global resurgence of measles in 2026, driven by decreased vaccination rates in various regions. It identifies outbreaks in both conflict-affected and peaceful countries, emphasizing the role of vaccine shortages and access issues in low-income areas. The research underscores the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage to achieve herd immunity and prevent epidemics, while noting the limitations of case confirmation in some regions. The findings suggest that addressing these challenges requires tailored public health strategies, especially in countries facing political instability or economic constraints.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了 2026 年 麻疹 病例上升的全球公共卫生问题,强调需要了解导致这种增加的因素以及相关风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是 2026 年进行的全球流行病学分析,研究了非洲、亚洲、美洲和欧洲等不同地区的 麻疹 病例,重点关注经历 麻疹 的国家和 疫苗接种 发病率差异。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用全球健康数据,包括 疫苗接种 覆盖率、暴发 报告和公共卫生观察结果,来确定影响 麻疹、传播 和 发病率 的趋势和因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,2026 年的 麻疹 流行病与 疫苗接种 发病率下降有关,受冲突影响的国家以及马尔代夫和赞比亚等和平国家报告了具体病例。在孟加拉国,疫苗 短缺和资金问题导致 麻疹 病例和死亡人数大幅上升。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,麻疹 在全球范围内流行的根本原因是 麻疹 发病率的下降,他们指出,由于情况和挑战不同,各个国家的情况也有所不同。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明维持高 疫苗接种 率以预防 暴发 的重要性,并强调需要在政治不稳定的低收入国家和地区采取有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于许多低收入国家缺乏确切的病例数,证据有限,因为只有一小部分 麻疹 病例是通过实验室检测确诊的。该研究根据报告的观察结果和公共卫生数据对情况进行了适度的评估。

Home Arts + Culture Economy Education Environment + Energy Ethics + Religion Health Politics + Society Science + Tech World Podcasts Local En Español Edition Africa Australia Brasil Canada Canada (français) Català España Europe France Global Indonesia New Zealand United Kingdom United States Donate Skip to content Edition: United States Africa Australia Brasil Canada Canada (français) Català España Europe France Global Indonesia New Zealand United Kingdom s Donate Newsletters Become an author Sign up as a reader Sign in Academic rigor, journalistic flair Arts + Culture Economy Education Environment + Energy Ethics + Religion Health Politics + Society Science + Tech World Podcasts Local Bangladesh has been experiencing measles outbreaks since May 2026, with more than 900 measles deaths. Sony Ramani/NurPhoto via Getty Images Why millions of people around the world will contract measles in 2026 Published: August 21, 2026 8:34am EDT The World Health Organization estimates that in 2026 nearly 11 million people will contract the virus that causes measles. Most of these cases will occur in Africa and Asia, but many countries in the Americas and Europe are reporting outbreaks affecting hundreds or thousands of people. There is no treatment for measles, but vaccines have been proven to be safe and effective at preventing the disease. Unvaccinated people who get sick with measles are at risk of serious complications that can lead to deafness, blindness and death. The risk of a bad outcome is higher for people who are undernourished and unable to access supportive medical care. As an infectious disease epidemiologist, I study the reasons for changes in population health risks around the world. The specific factors leading to measles epidemics vary by country, but the underlying cause everywhere is decreased vaccination rates. Zero-dose children in low-income countries The vast majority of parents around the world want to protect their children from preventable infectious diseases through vaccination. In many lower-income countries, the supply of vaccines remains insufficient to meet the demand for them. Because measles is highly contagious, the vaccination rate needs to be above 95% to protect a community from outbreaks, creating what is known as “herd immunity.” One dose of measles vaccine protects most people from the disease, but two doses are recommended to improve effectiveness. Most high-income countries have measles vaccine rates near the 95% target. In Europe, the average one-dose vaccination rate is about 94%, and the two-dose rate is about 88%. In the U.S., more than 90% of 2-year-olds have received at least one dose of measles vaccine and more than 92% of kindergartners have received two doses. The vaccine coverage rate is above 95% in many communities, though it is much lower in some school districts. In contrast, only about 80% of young children in low- and middle-income countries have received at least one dose of measles vaccine, and only about 70% have received two doses. Almost every country had reduced access to vaccines during the early months of the COVID-19 pandemic, when supply chains and clinic access were severely disrupted. Most young children in high-income countries were able to catch up on missed doses before they reached school age. But in lower-income countries, millions of kids who missed routine vaccinations during the pandemic are still classified as “zero-dose children” who have not received any of the vaccines their countries recommend. Only a tiny fraction of the cases of measles diagnosed in lower-income countries are confirmed with laboratory tests and reported to public health authorities, so it’s impossible to get an exact case count. But healthcare workers have reported observing higher than typical numbers of cases in many countries during the past year. In 2026, measles epidemics have been reported in countries experiencing armed conflict or housing refugees displaced by war, such as Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Somalia, Sudan and Yemen. Outbreaks have also been reported in peaceful countries, including Maldives and Zambia, and cases are surging in India. Dozens of other countries are also experiencing epidemics. All of these situations are linked to undervaccination. Vaccine shortages in Bangladesh Bangladesh has reported more measles cases this year than any other country, and more than 900 people have died from the infection. While Bangladesh faces many of the same challenges as other low- and middle-income countries, the past few years have presented some unique difficulties. In 2024, the country’s longtime government collapsed and an interim government was installed. During this time of political instability the government ordered too few vaccine doses. In 2025 vaccine shortages worsened when the interim government decided to stop procuring its vaccines through UNICEF and instead tried to purchase them through a competitive bidding process before new supply chains had been established. Bangladesh has now resumed working with UNICEF to acquire vaccines. Unfortunately, it has returned to UNICEF at a time when its partner organization Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, is facing funding cuts. Under Gavi’s cofinancing model, low- and middle-income countries’ initial vaccine purchases are subsidized by contributions from high-income countries and other investors. Over time, countries pay an increasing portion of their own vaccine costs. Because Gavi pools orders from all over the world, it is able to shape markets and negotiate with vaccine manufacturers for lower costs per dose. The major limitation of this system is that reduced funding for global health shrinks the budget for subsidizing vaccine purchases. The ongoing measles outbreak in Bangladesh is the result of a unique combination of political upheaval and a shortage of vaccines. But since 2025, France, Germany, the U.K., the U.S. and several other high-income countries have significantly reduced their budgets for development assistance, leaving Gavi with a substantial budget shortfall. As Bangladesh has grown its economy, it is paying a greater share of the costs of the vaccines it purchases through Gavi. However, it does not yet have the means to fully self-finance its vaccine program. For now, if Gavi’s budget is not fully replenished, countries like Bangladesh will not have enough money to buy all of the vaccines they need. Even though a mass vaccination campaign in early 2026 saw more than 1 million Bangladeshi children vaccinated against measles, the percentage of children who have been vaccinated remains far below the 95% threshold required to prevent widespread epidemics. In the midst of a measles outbreak in February 2026, health authorities in Mexico organized a major vaccination campaign, administering shots in metro stations and other public gathering places around the country. Gerardo Vieyra/NurPhoto via Getty Images Vaccine hesitancy in faith communities in the Americas Two years ago the entire region of the Americas – North, Central, and South America and the Caribbean – was classified as a measles-free zone. Canada officially lost its measles elimination status in November 2025 after more than a year of sustained transmission. Mexico and the U.S. have met the criteria to lose their measles-free status when the Pan American Health Organization’s measles elimination committee meets again in November 2026. The country reporting the largest number of measles cases in the Americas in 2026 is Guatemala, which has already logged more than 30,000 confirmed cases. The Guatemalan epidemic has been traced back to a gathering in Santiago Atitlán in December 2025 that was organized by a Christian megachurch whose leaders have been vocal about their anti-vaccine views. Measles began circulating in late 2024 and early 2025 in Canada, Mexico and the U.S. among rural, conservative Mennonite communities where leaving children unvaccinated has become the cultural norm. In South Carolina and Utah, recent outbreaks have been linked to low vaccination rates among conservative religious groups that are not connected with Mennonite churches. More cases of measles have already been diagnosed in the U.S. in 2026 than in any year since 1991. The measles virus has moved from religious communities into other undervaccinated population groups. The epidemic that started in Mennonite villages in Mexico spread into neighboring Indigenous communities. An outbreak that started among German-speaking Mennonites in Bolivia crossed the border into Peru and was then amplified by visitors to large cultural festivals who brought the virus home with them. Stopping the spread The total number of measles cases per year decreased from an estimated 38 million in 2000 to about 10 million in 2019. That trend has reversed since the COVID-19 pandemic. The number of measles cases and the number of countries experiencing measles epidemics has gone up as the vaccination rate in some populations has gone down. Getting back on track toward eliminating measles as a global public health problem will look different depending on the circumstances in each country. For low- and middle-income countries, ending measles epidemics will require increasing funding for Gavi and other international partnerships so that the vaccine supply can grow to meet the demand. The need is different in countries where vaccination rates are falling even though measles vaccines are readily available. Stopping the spread of measles in undervaccinated communities will depend on the challenging task of building vaccine confidence among parents of young children. papers.title: Safety and immunogenicity of the synthetic carbohydrate conjugate vaccine, SF2a-TT15, against Shigella flexneri 2a in infants in Kenya: a phase 2a, age-descending, dose-escalating, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Shigella is the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in children younger than 5 years in low- and middle-income countries and is a major actor in antimicrobial resistance. An effective vaccine is urgently needed. SF2a-TT15, a conjugate featuring a synthetic 15-mer oligosaccharide surrogate of the O-antigen component of Shigella flexneri 2a (SF2a) lipopolysaccharide, was previously shown to be safe and immunogenic in a first-in-human study. We aimed to assess its safety and immunogenicity in infants from an endemic setting, the target population for a Shigella vaccine. METHODS: We conducted a phase 2a, age-descending, dose-escalating, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled study at the Clinical Research Center, Kenya Medical Research Institute/Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (Kericho, Kenya). Healthy adults aged 18-50 years and healthy children aged 2-5 years with a weight-for-age Z score of -2 or more were randomly assigned (3:1) to receive a 10 μg oligosaccharide dose of SF2a-TT15 adjuvanted with aluminium hydroxide (alum) or matching placebo. Healthy infants aged 9 months plus or minus 1 month with a weight-for-age Z score of -2 or more were randomly assigned (3:3:3:3:1:1) in a stepwise manner to receive a 2 μg oligosaccharide dose of non-alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, a 2 μg oligosaccharide dose of alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, a 10 μg oligosaccharide dose of non-alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, a 10 μg oligosaccharide dose of alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, non-alum-adjuvanted placebo, or alum-adjuvanted placebo, concomitantly with routine measles-rubella vaccination. Study products were administered intramuscularly on day 0, 90, and 270, with a 6-month follow-up after the last injection. The randomisation sequence was computer-generated and randomisation was stratified by cohort and treatment group. Syringes were over-labelled before injection to maintain masking; all clinical site teams were masked except the pharmacist team, including the pharmacy data quality monitoring team, and one person in the Institut Pasteur team. All participants were also masked. Progression between cohorts and dose levels was overseen by an independent data monitoring committee. The primary outcomes were the incidence of adverse events in all cohorts and immunogenicity in the infant cohort, as measured at days 14 and 28 after each injection and at the end of the study by serum IgG antibodies to SF2a lipopolysaccharide and proportion of responders. Safety endpoints were analysed in all participants receiving at least one injection and immunogenicity endpoints were analysed in the full analysis set and in the per-protocol analysis set. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04602975, and is completed. FINDINGS: Enrolment was between Oct 26, 2020, and Jan 5, 2022. 54 adults were screened for eligibility, 16 of whom were enrolled and randomly assigned to the adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=12) or adjuvanted placebo (n=4). 30 children were screened for eligibility, 16 of whom were enrolled and randomly assigned to the adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=12) or adjuvanted placebo (n=4). 413 infants were screened for eligibility, 216 of whom were enrolled and randomly assigned to the non-adjuvanted 2 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=46), the adjuvanted 2 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=44), the non-adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=41), the adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=43), non-adjuvanted placebo (n=22), or adjuvanted placebo (n=20). 112 (52%) of 215 infants in the safety analysis set were female and 103 (48%) were male. The SF2a-TT15 glycoconjugate was well tolerated and induced high serum IgG geometric mean titres (GMTs) to SF2a lipopolysaccharide in adults and children. In infants, SF2a-TT15 was well tolerated at both doses, adjuvanted or non-adjuvanted, with no vaccine-related serious adverse events. 202 (94%) of 216 infants had at least one unsolicited adverse event. 182 (90%) of these infants had adverse events considered not related to study products. No significant differences in the frequency of unsolicited adverse events were reported between any treatment groups (p>0·05 for all comparisons). 1235 adverse events were recorded in the infant cohort, most being unrelated to the study product (1226 [99%]) and of mild (744 [60%]) or moderate (435 [35%]) grading. At 28 days after each injection and for both doses, adjuvanted or non-adjuvanted, SF2a-TT15 induced significantly higher serum IgG GMTs to SF2a lipopolysaccharide compared with corresponding GMTs in placebo recipients (p=0·047 for the non-adjuvanted 2 μg oligosaccharide dose 28 days after the first injection and p 0·5 for all timepoints). At the end of the study, for both doses, adjuvanted or not, GMTs were decreased but were still significantly elevated compared with the placebo group (p<0·001). INTERPRETATION: SF2a-TT15 is well tolerated and strongly immunogenic in Kenyan infants, showing potential for further development. Available data support advancing a multivalent synthetic glycan-based Shigella vaccine. FUNDING: Gates Foundation, The Wellcome Trust, The European Union Seventh Framework Programme, Laboratoire d'Excellence Integrative Biology of Emerging Infectious Diseases, and Institut Pasteur. TRANSLATION: For the Kiswahili translation of the abstract see Supplementary Materials section.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of SF2a-TT15, a synthetic carbohydrate conjugate vaccine against Shigella flexneri 2a, in Kenyan infants. The phase 2a, age-descending, dose-escalating, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial enrolled 216 infants and assessed adverse events and immune responses. SF2a-TT15 was well tolerated with no serious vaccine-related adverse events. It induced significantly higher serum IgG geometric mean titres (GMTs) to SF2a lipopolysaccharide compared to placebo, indicating strong immunogenicity. The results suggest that SF2a-TT15 has potential for further development as a Shigella vaccine. However, the study was limited to a single endemic setting, which may affect generalisability.

papers.title_zh: 合成碳水化合物缀合物 疫苗、SF2a-TT15 针对肯尼亚婴儿福氏志贺菌 2a 的安全性和免疫原性:一项 2a 期、年龄递减、剂量递增、双盲、随机、安慰剂对照研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Shigella is the leading cause of morbidity and mortality in children younger than 5 years in low- and middle-income countries and is a major actor in antimicrobial resistance. An effective vaccine is urgently needed. SF2a-TT15, a conjugate featuring a synthetic 15-mer oligosaccharide surrogate of the O-antigen component of Shigella flexneri 2a (SF2a) lipopolysaccharide, was previously shown to be safe and immunogenic in a first-in-human study. We aimed to assess its safety and immunogenicity in infants from an endemic setting, the target population for a Shigella vaccine. METHODS: We conducted a phase 2a, age-descending, dose-escalating, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled study at the Clinical Research Center, Kenya Medical Research Institute/Walter Reed Army Institute of Research (Kericho, Kenya). Healthy adults aged 18-50 years and healthy children aged 2-5 years with a weight-for-age Z score of -2 or more were randomly assigned (3:1) to receive a 10 μg oligosaccharide dose of SF2a-TT15 adjuvanted with aluminium hydroxide (alum) or matching placebo. Healthy infants aged 9 months plus or minus 1 month with a weight-for-age Z score of -2 or more were randomly assigned (3:3:3:3:1:1) in a stepwise manner to receive a 2 μg oligosaccharide dose of non-alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, a 2 μg oligosaccharide dose of alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, a 10 μg oligosaccharide dose of non-alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, a 10 μg oligosaccharide dose of alum-adjuvanted SF2a-TT15, non-alum-adjuvanted placebo, or alum-adjuvanted placebo, concomitantly with routine measles-rubella vaccination. Study products were administered intramuscularly on day 0, 90, and 270, with a 6-month follow-up after the last injection. The randomisation sequence was computer-generated and randomisation was stratified by cohort and treatment group. Syringes were over-labelled before injection to maintain masking; all clinical site teams were masked except the pharmacist team, including the pharmacy data quality monitoring team, and one person in the Institut Pasteur team. All participants were also masked. Progression between cohorts and dose levels was overseen by an independent data monitoring committee. The primary outcomes were the incidence of adverse events in all cohorts and immunogenicity in the infant cohort, as measured at days 14 and 28 after each injection and at the end of the study by serum IgG antibodies to SF2a lipopolysaccharide and proportion of responders. Safety endpoints were analysed in all participants receiving at least one injection and immunogenicity endpoints were analysed in the full analysis set and in the per-protocol analysis set. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04602975, and is completed. FINDINGS: Enrolment was between Oct 26, 2020, and Jan 5, 2022. 54 adults were screened for eligibility, 16 of whom were enrolled and randomly assigned to the adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=12) or adjuvanted placebo (n=4). 30 children were screened for eligibility, 16 of whom were enrolled and randomly assigned to the adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=12) or adjuvanted placebo (n=4). 413 infants were screened for eligibility, 216 of whom were enrolled and randomly assigned to the non-adjuvanted 2 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=46), the adjuvanted 2 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=44), the non-adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=41), the adjuvanted 10 μg oligosaccharide dose (n=43), non-adjuvanted placebo (n=22), or adjuvanted placebo (n=20). 112 (52%) of 215 infants in the safety analysis set were female and 103 (48%) were male. The SF2a-TT15 glycoconjugate was well tolerated and induced high serum IgG geometric mean titres (GMTs) to SF2a lipopolysaccharide in adults and children. In infants, SF2a-TT15 was well tolerated at both doses, adjuvanted or non-adjuvanted, with no vaccine-related serious adverse events. 202 (94%) of 216 infants had at least one unsolicited adverse event. 182 (90%) of these infants had adverse events considered not related to study products. No significant differences in the frequency of unsolicited adverse events were reported between any treatment groups (p>0·05 for all comparisons). 1235 adverse events were recorded in the infant cohort, most being unrelated to the study product (1226 [99%]) and of mild (744 [60%]) or moderate (435 [35%]) grading. At 28 days after each injection and for both doses, adjuvanted or non-adjuvanted, SF2a-TT15 induced significantly higher serum IgG GMTs to SF2a lipopolysaccharide compared with corresponding GMTs in placebo recipients (p=0·047 for the non-adjuvanted 2 μg oligosaccharide dose 28 days after the first injection and p 0·5 for all timepoints). At the end of the study, for both doses, adjuvanted or not, GMTs were decreased but were still significantly elevated compared with the placebo group (p<0·001). INTERPRETATION: SF2a-TT15 is well tolerated and strongly immunogenic in Kenyan infants, showing potential for further development. Available data support advancing a multivalent synthetic glycan-based Shigella vaccine. FUNDING: Gates Foundation, The Wellcome Trust, The European Union Seventh Framework Programme, Laboratoire d'Excellence Integrative Biology of Emerging Infectious Diseases, and Institut Pasteur. TRANSLATION: For the Kiswahili translation of the abstract see Supplementary Materials section.

在两种剂量(佐剂或非佐剂)下均具有良好的耐受性,没有与 疫苗 相关的严重不良事件。216 名婴儿中的 202 名(94%)至少发生过一种未经请求的不良事件。其中 182 名 (90%) 婴儿出现了被认为与研究产品无关的不良事件。任何 治疗 组之间未报告主动不良事件发生频率存在显着差异(所有比较 p>0·05)。婴儿 队列研究 中记录了 1235 起不良事件,其中大多数与研究产品无关 (1226 [99%]),分级为轻度 (744 [60%]) 或中度 (435 [35%])。每次注射后 28 天,无论有佐剂还是无佐剂,SF2a-TT15 均诱导 SF2a 脂多糖的血清 IgG GMT 显着高于安慰剂接受者的相应 GMT(首次注射后 28 天,无佐剂 2 μg 寡糖剂量的 p = 0·047,所有时间点的 p = 0·5)。研究结束时,无论是否有辅助治疗,两种剂量的 GMT 均有所下降,但与安慰剂组相比仍显着升高 (p<0·001)。解释:SF2a-TT15 在肯尼亚婴儿中具有良好的耐受性和强免疫原性,显示出进一步发展的潜力。现有数据支持推进基于多价合成聚糖的志贺氏菌 疫苗。资助:盖茨基金会、威康信托基金、欧盟第七框架计划、新兴传染病卓越综合生物学实验室和巴斯德研究所。翻译:有关摘要的斯瓦西里语翻译,请参阅补充材料部分。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 志贺氏菌是低收入和中等收入国家 5 岁以下儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因,也是抗菌素耐药性的主要因素。迫切需要一个有效的疫苗。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们在肯尼亚医学研究所/沃尔特里德陆军研究所(肯尼亚凯里乔)临床研究中心进行了一项 2a 期、年龄递减、剂量递增、双盲、随机、安慰剂对照研究。年龄别体重 Z 评分为 -2 或更高的 18-50 岁健康成人和 2-5 岁健康儿童被随机分配 (3:1) 接受 10 μg 低聚糖剂量的 SF2a-TT15 佐以氢氧化铝(明矾)或匹配的安慰剂。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究产品在第 0 天、第 90 天和第 270 天进行肌内注射,最后一次注射后进行 6 个月的随访。随机化序列由计算机生成,随机化按 队列研究 和 治疗 组进行分层。对接受至少一次注射的所有参与者的安全性终点进行了分析,并在完整分析集中和按方案分析集中对免疫原性终点进行了分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在婴儿中,SF2a-TT15 在两种剂量(佐剂或非佐剂)下均具有良好的耐受性,没有与 疫苗 相关的严重不良事件。216 名婴儿中的 202 名(94%)至少发生过一种未经请求的不良事件。其中 182 名 (90%) 婴儿出现了被认为与研究产品无关的不良事件。任何 治疗 组之间未报告主动不良事件发生频率存在显着差异(所有比较 p>0·05)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: SF2a-TT15 在肯尼亚婴儿中具有良好的耐受性和强免疫原性,显示出进一步发展的潜力。现有数据支持推进基于多价合成聚糖的志贺氏菌 疫苗。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,SF2a-TT15 可能是志贺氏菌 疫苗 的有希望的候选者,特别是对于流行地区的婴儿。疫苗在婴儿中的安全性和免疫原性为未来疫苗的开发和实施提供了重要数据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在单一流行环境中进行的,这可能会限制普遍性。对于婴儿的安全性和免疫原性,有强有力的证据,但需要进一步的研究来在更大、更多样化的人群中证实这些发现。

papers.title: Assessment of Commercial Lateral Flow Immunoassays for Rubella IgM Detection in Serum Samples.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Rubella is generally a mild exanthematous disease, but infection during early pregnancy can result in congenital rubella syndrome (CRS). Accurate and timely diagnosis is essential for surveillance and outbreak control. The use of enzyme immunoassays (EIA) for the detection of rubella-specific IgM antibodies as recommended by WHO is limited by infrastructure, trained staff, and transport requirements. Lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA)-based rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) could aid decentralized testing, yet data on their performance are currently limited. METHODS: Nine commercially available rubella IgM RDTs were evaluated using a serum panel and two EIAs for comparison. The panel included serial dilutions of rubella IgM positive controls and pooled IgM positive sera, as well as rubella IgM negative pooled sera, a strong IgG positive sample, and a measles IgM positive sample. RESULTS: Most RDTs showed substantially lower analytical sensitivity than EIAs, detecting IgM only at higher antibody concentrations. Two RDTs demonstrated an apparently higher sensitivity but reduced specificity. No interference from high rubella IgG levels was observed. CONCLUSION: Overall, the rubella IgM RDTs included in this study displayed substantial limitations in sensitivity and/or specificity. While they may support rapid case identification in settings with limited laboratory capacity, results should be interpreted cautiously and confirmed by EIA, particularly in elimination settings.

The research aimed to evaluate the analytical sensitivity and specificity of these RDTs, as accurate and timely diagnosis is essential for rubella surveillance and outbreak control. Two RDTs demonstrated higher sensitivity but reduced specificity, while no interference from high rubella IgG levels was observed. The study's findings highlight the importance of using EIA for reliable diagnosis, but the evidence is moderate due to the controlled laboratory setting and lack of real-world validation.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:风疹通常是一种轻微的出疹性疾病,但妊娠早期感染可导致先天性风疹综合征(CRS)。准确及时的诊断对于监测和暴发控制至关重要。根据 WHO 的建议,使用酶免疫分析 (EIA) 检测风疹特异性 IgM 抗体受到基础设施、训练有素的工作人员和运输要求的限制。基于侧流免疫分析 (LFIA) 的快速诊断测试 (RDT) 可以帮助分散测试,但目前有关其性能的数据有限。方法:使用血清组和两种 EIA 来评估九种市售风疹 IgM RDT 进行比较。该小组包括风疹 IgM 阳性对照和混合 IgM 阳性血清的系列稀释液,以及风疹 IgM 阴性混合血清、强 IgG 阳性样品和 麻疹 IgM 阳性样品。结果:大多数 RDT 的分析灵敏度明显低于 EIA,仅在较高抗体浓度下检测 IgM。两项 RDT 表现出明显较高的敏感性,但特异性降低。没有观察到高风疹 IgG 水平的干扰。结论:总体而言,本研究中包含的风疹 IgM RDT 在敏感性和/或特异性方面显示出很大的局限性。虽然它们可能支持在实验室能力有限的环境中快速识别病例,但结果应谨慎解释并由 EIA 确认,特别是在消除环境中。

papers.title: Microneedles for Vaccination: Mechanistic Foundations, Materials Innovation, Clinical Translation, and Global Health Implementation
papers.abstract: Vaccination ranks among the most consequential interventions in medicine, yet cold-chain dependence, sharps hazards, needle phobia, and reliance on trained vaccinators limit coverage where vaccine-preventable mortality is highest. Microneedle patches deposit antigen into the antigen-presenting-cell-rich epidermis and upper dermis through projections that penetrate the stratum corneum without reaching dermal nociceptors. Such targeting yields immunogenicity matching or exceeding intramuscular injection at a fraction of the antigen mass, with dose-sparing up to six-fold recorded for influenza, polio, and SARS-CoV-2 antigens. Solid-state formulation converts that immunological advantage into a logistical one, since polymeric matrices preserve potency for as long as two years at ambient temperature, removing the refrigeration infrastructure that consumes significant delivery cost. Six microneedle types have reached preclinical or clinical maturity, with dissolving microneedle patches the most advanced. Two trials provide the clinical evidence: a Phase I influenza study showing non-inferior antibody responses and successful self-application, and a Phase I/II measles–rubella trial in The Gambia reaching 93% measles and 100% rubella seroconversion in infants without related serious adverse events. Engineering advances currently include an automated printer producing thermostable mRNA–lipid nanoparticle patches that retain bioactivity for six months at ambient temperature, the first intradermal self-amplifying RNA patch, and quantum-dot on-body immunization records. Sterility assurance, dose uniformity, nucleic acid integrity within solid matrices, and fragmented regulatory guidance remain the challenging obstacles, alongside a clinical pipeline concentrated on few antigens. This review integrates the mechanistic, materials, manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, and global health dimensions of the field to guide translation and equitable deployment.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the use of microneedles for vaccination, particularly in the context of measles virus. The central question is whether microneedles can serve as an effective and efficient alternative to traditional injection methods for measles vaccination, considering their immunogenicity, logistical advantages, and clinical translation potential.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of the mechanistic, materials, manufacturing, clinical, regulatory, and global health dimensions of microneedle technology. It includes two clinical trials: a Phase I influenza study and a Phase I/II measles–rubella trial in The Gambia. The review integrates findings from these trials and other preclinical and clinical studies to evaluate the potential of microneedles for measles vaccination.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Microneedle patches demonstrate immunogenicity matching or exceeding intramuscular injection, with dose-sparing benefits observed for measles antigens. The measles–rubella trial in The Gambia showed 93% measles and 100% rubella seroconversion in infants without serious adverse events, supporting the clinical potential of microneedles for measles vaccination.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights challenges such as sterility assurance, dose uniformity, and nucleic acid integrity within solid matrices. Additionally, the clinical pipeline is concentrated on a limited number of antigens, and regulatory guidance remains fragmented, creating gaps in the evidence for broader application of microneedles in measles vaccination.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests the need for further research on microneedle technology for measles, including improvements in sterility, dose uniformity, and regulatory frameworks. It also emphasizes the importance of expanding the clinical pipeline to include more measles-related antigens and ensuring equitable deployment of this technology in global health settings.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the potential of microneedles for measles vaccination, focusing on their immunogenicity, logistical advantages, and clinical translation. Microneedle patches deliver antigens to the epidermis and upper dermis, achieving immunogenicity comparable to intramuscular injection while requiring less antigen mass. A Phase I/II measles–rubella trial in The Gambia demonstrated high seroconversion rates without serious adverse events. Despite these findings, challenges such as sterility assurance, dose uniformity, and regulatory fragmentation remain. The review advocates for further research and development to address these issues and expand the clinical pipeline for measles-specific microneedle vaccines.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本次审查的重点是微针在 疫苗接种 中的使用,特别是在 麻疹病毒 的背景下。核心问题是,考虑到微针的免疫原性、后勤优势和临床转化潜力,微针是否可以作为 麻疹 疫苗接种 传统注射方法的有效替代品。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述对微针技术的机械、材料、制造、临床、监管和全球健康维度进行了全面分析。它包括两项临床试验:一项 I 期流感研究和一项在冈比亚进行的 I/II 期 麻疹 风疹试验。该综述综合了这些试验以及其他临床前和临床研究的结果,以评估微针用于 麻疹 疫苗接种 的潜力。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 微针贴片的免疫原性与肌肉注射相当或更优,且在针对麻疹抗原时观察到剂量节约效益。在冈比亚进行的麻疹–风疹试验中,婴儿的麻疹血清阳转率为93%,风疹血清阳转率为100%,且未出现严重不良事件,支持微针技术在麻疹疫苗接种中的临床潜力。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了固体基质中的无菌保证、剂量均匀性和核酸完整性等挑战。此外,临床管道集中在有限数量的抗原上,监管指导仍然支离破碎,导致在麻疹 疫苗接种中更广泛应用微针的证据方面存在差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查表明需要对 麻疹 的微针技术进行进一步研究,包括无菌性、剂量均匀性和监管框架的改进。它还强调了扩大临床管道以包括更多 麻疹 相关抗原并确保在全球卫生环境中公平部署该技术的重要性。

papers.abstract_zh: 疫苗接种 属于最重要的医学干预措施之一,但冷链依赖、锐器危险、针头恐惧症和对训练有素的疫苗接种员的依赖限制了 疫苗 可预防的 死亡率 的覆盖范围。微针贴片通过穿透角质层的突出物将抗原沉积到富含抗原呈递细胞的表皮和上层真皮中,但不会到达真皮伤害感受器。这种靶向产生的免疫原性与抗原质量的一小部分相匹配或超过肌内注射,流感、脊髓灰质炎和 SARS-CoV-2 抗原的剂量节省高达六倍。固态制剂将这种免疫学优势转化为物流优势,因为聚合物基质在环境温度下可保持效力长达两年,从而消除了消耗大量运输成本的制冷基础设施。六种微针类型已达到临床前或临床成熟,其中可溶性微针贴片最为先进。两项试验提供了临床证据:一项 I 期流感研究显示出非劣效的抗体反应和成功的自我应用,以及一项在冈比亚进行的 I/II 期 麻疹-风疹试验,婴儿中 麻疹 达到 93%,风疹血清转化率为 100%,没有相关的严重不良事件。目前的工程进展包括自动打印机,可生产耐热 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒贴片,在环境温度下可保持生物活性六个月,第一个皮内自放大 RNA 贴片,以及量子点体内免疫记录。无菌保证、剂量均匀性、固体基质内的核酸完整性和分散的监管指导仍然是具有挑战性的障碍,同时临床管道集中于少数抗原。本次审查整合了该领域的机械、材料、制造、临床、监管和全球健康维度,以指导翻译和公平部署。

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查表明需要对 麻疹 的微针技术进行进一步研究,包括无菌性、剂量均匀性和监管框架的改进。它还强调了扩大临床管道以包括更多 麻疹 相关抗原并确保在全球卫生环境中公平部署该技术的重要性。

S1):s15–s16 doi:10.1017/ash.2026.10450 Presentation Type: Top Poster Abstract Subject Category: Occupational Health Abstract ID: 298 Genomic Epidemiology Demonstrates that Decolonization reduces Staphylococcus aureus transmission in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit Kayla Ruch1 and Mayar Al Mohajer2 1Becton Dickinson (BD) and 2Baylor College of Medicine Background: Infection preventionists (IPs) increasingly lead systemwide healthcare epidemiology functions integrating infection prevention, anti- microbial stewardship, and preparedness for emerging pathogens. The Advanced Leadership Certification in Infection Prevention and Control (AL-CIP) is the first credential to formally assess advanced IPC leadership competencies, yet the leadership practices, epidemiologic decision-making, and risk management strategies employed by certified professionals have not been empirically described. Methods: The Leadership Evaluation and Development for Infection Preventionists (LEAD-IP) study used an obser- vational nested cohort design. Secondary portfolio data from AL-CIP applicants across two 2025 certification cycles were analyzed to character- ize demographic and professional attributes. A nested cohort of certified professionals (18%) completed a structured 60-minute qualitative inter- view via Microsoft Teams. Interviews followed the IRB-approved 34-item LEAD-IP instrument assessing leadership behaviors, healthcare epidemi- ology decision-making, antimicrobial stewardship engagement, risk assessment practices, communication strategies, and preparedness for emerging pathogens. Data were managed in REDCap and analyzed using Braun and Clarke’s inductive thematic analysis with a structured code- book, triangulation, and verification of thematic saturation. Results: Thirty AL-CIP–certified leaders across healthcare systems, public health agencies, and academic settings participated. Across seven themes, partic- ipants described a shift from task-based practice to systems-level health- care epidemiology leadership, integrating surveillance data, antimicrobial resistance patterns, and organizational risk indicators into strategic direction-setting. Leaders emphasized dashboards, analytic tools, and improvement models to detect outbreaks earlier, evaluate stewardship interventions, and guide resource allocation. Transparent communication and psychological safety facilitated early escalation of HAI clusters, anti- biotic misuse, environmental risks, and emerging pathogen concerns such as Candida auris. Participants reported persistent public health infrastruc- ture limitations, including fragmented reporting pathways, inconsistent data-sharing with health departments, and delays in organism identifica- tion that impeded timely epidemiologic response. Significant antibiotic stewardship gaps were also identified—particularly limited analytic capac- ity, insufficient infectious disease support, and low organizational priori- tization. Structural barriers such as staffing shortages and limited protected time constrained proactive IPC and stewardship leadership. Inclusive engagement of under-resourced teams improved situational awareness and intervention success. Proactive risk management—monitoring con- struction, airflow disruptions, MDRO trends, and public health alerts— was viewed as essential. AL-CIP certification strengthened leadership iden- tity, credibility, and strategic influence. Conclusions: AL-CIP–certified professionals demonstrated advanced capabilities in healthcare epidemiol- ogy, antibiotic stewardship, and public health preparedness through sys- tems thinking, data-driven decision-making, inclusive engagement, and proactive risk management. The AL-CIP credential enhanced leaders’ confidence and organizational impact, supporting a more resilient and pre- pared healthcare epidemiology workforce. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the impact of genomic epidemiology on reducing Staphylococcus aureus transmission in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit, addressing the need for improved infection prevention strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used an observational nested cohort design, analyzing secondary portfolio data from AL-CIP applicants across two 2025 certification cycles, with a nested cohort of certified professionals (18%) completing structured interviews.
analysis.methods: Data were managed in REDCap and analyzed using Braun and Clarke’s inductive thematic analysis with a structured code-book, triangulation, and verification of thematic saturation.
analysis.main_results: Thirty AL-CIP–certified leaders across healthcare systems, public health agencies, and academic settings participated. Leaders emphasized dashboards, analytic tools, and improvement models to detect outbreaks earlier, evaluate stewardship interventions, and guide resource allocation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that genomic epidemiology can enhance leadership practices in infection prevention by integrating surveillance data, antimicrobial resistance patterns, and organizational risk indicators into strategic decision-making.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the potential of genomic epidemiology to improve outbreak detection, stewardship interventions, and resource allocation, with implications for strengthening public health infrastructure and leadership in infectious disease control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and the absence of direct transmission measurements, but the evidence is supported by structured interviews and thematic analysis, providing a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the role of genomic epidemiology in reducing Staphylococcus aureus transmission within a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit. It evaluates the impact of the Advanced Leadership Certification in Infection Prevention and Control (AL-CIP) on leadership practices, emphasizing the shift from task-based to systems-level healthcare epidemiology. The study used an observational nested cohort design, analyzing data from AL-CIP applicants and conducting structured interviews with certified professionals. Results showed that leaders utilized dashboards and analytic tools to detect outbreaks earlier and guide resource allocation. The findings suggest that genomic epidemiology can enhance strategic decision-making by integrating surveillance data and resistance patterns. The study highlights the importance of leadership in infection prevention and identifies persistent public health infrastructure limitations. However, the reliance on self-reported data and lack of direct transmission measurements limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in a moderate assessment of evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估基因组 流行病学 对减少新生儿重症监护病房中金黄色葡萄球菌 传播 的影响,满足改进感染预防策略的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用观察性嵌套 队列研究 设计,分析 AL-CIP 申请人在两个 2025 年认证周期中的二级作品集数据,并由完成结构化面试的认证专业人士 (18%) 进行嵌套 队列研究。
elements_zh.methods: 数据在 REDCap 中进行管理,并使用 Braun 和 Clarke 的归纳主题分析以及结构化密码本、三角测量和主题饱和度验证进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 来自医疗保健系统、公共卫生机构和学术机构的 30 名 AL-CIP 认证领导者参加了此次活动。领导者强调仪表板、分析工具和改进模型,以更早地发现 暴发、评估管理干预措施并指导资源分配。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,基因组 流行病学 可以通过将 监测 数据、抗菌药物耐药模式和组织风险指标整合到战略决策中来增强感染预防方面的领导实践。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果凸显了基因组 流行病学 在改善 暴发 检测、管理干预和资源分配方面的潜力,对加强公共卫生基础设施和传染病控制领导力具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖自我报告的数据且缺乏直接的 传播 测量而受到限制,但证据得到结构化访谈和主题分析的支持,提供了适度的置信度评估。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估基因组 流行病学 对减少新生儿重症监护病房中金黄色葡萄球菌 传播 的影响,满足改进感染预防策略的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用观察性嵌套 队列研究 设计,分析 AL-CIP 申请人在两个 2025 年认证周期中的二级作品集数据,并由完成结构化面试的认证专业人士 (18%) 进行嵌套 队列研究。
analysis_zh.methods: 数据在 REDCap 中进行管理,并使用 Braun 和 Clarke 的归纳主题分析以及结构化密码本、三角测量和主题饱和度验证进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 来自医疗保健系统、公共卫生机构和学术机构的 30 名 AL-CIP 认证领导者参加了此次活动。领导者强调仪表板、分析工具和改进模型,以更早地发现 暴发、评估管理干预措施并指导资源分配。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,基因组 流行病学 可以通过将 监测 数据、抗菌药物耐药模式和组织风险指标整合到战略决策中来增强感染预防方面的领导实践。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果凸显了基因组 流行病学 在改善 暴发 检测、管理干预和资源分配方面的潜力,对加强公共卫生基础设施和传染病控制领导力具有影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于依赖自我报告的数据且缺乏直接的 传播 测量而受到限制,但证据得到结构化访谈和主题分析的支持,提供了适度的置信度评估。

S1):s191–s192 doi:10.1017/ash.2026.10739 Presentation Type: Poster Presentation Subject Category: VAE Abstract ID: 360 Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance in the Cuautla River, Mexico Nicole Jackson1 MSOL, CIC, Atrium Health Navicent Background: Ventilator-associated events (VAEs) are episodes of respira- tory deterioration after stability during mechanical ventilation, posing sig- nificant risks for morbidity and mortality. Extremely low birth weight neonates (<750 g), particularly those born at 22–24 weeks gestation, are highly vulnerable. In our Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), eight VAEs occurred in the previous year, leading to prolonged ventilation, increased infection risk, and higher mortality. Reducing VAEs is essential for improving patient safety, health equity, and family experience while meeting NHSN benchmarks and regulatory goals. Methods: A structured, evidence-based approach was implemented using failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) to identify risk factors and guide interventions. A multi- disciplinary team developed a formalized VAE prevention bundle, which included: - Formation of a multidisciplinary task force - Process measures tied to critical clinical tasks - Creation of an EHR tool for real-time com- pliance monitoring - Staff education and workflow alignment - Cultural engagement initiatives to reinforce best practices Pre- and post-interven- tion data were collected and analyzed for neonates <750 g per NHSN guidelines. Result: Post-implementation, VAE rates decreased from 9.8 to zero per 1,000 ventilator days, achieving an SIR ?1.0 and meeting national benchmarks. Mortality among extremely low birth weight neo- nates declined by 60%. Integration of EHR visualization and Power BI dashboards enabled real-time monitoring and sustained compliance. The initiative generated an estimated annual cost savings of $2.1 million through reduced length of stay and infection-related expenses. Conclusion: Structured care bundles, integrated data tools, and multidis- ciplinary engagement can eliminate VAEs in high-risk neonates. Broader adoption across NICUs could enhance patient safety, reduce healthcare costs, and improve outcomes systemwide. Innovative clinical practice plays a pivotal role in sustaining these improvements through adherence to pre- vention bundles, leveraging technology for real-time compliance, and fos- tering a culture of accountability. Standardized frameworks and education strategies can be scaled across institutions for continuous improvement. References Bondarev DJ, Ryan RM, Mukherjee D. (2024). analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the rising global measles cases and the need to increase vaccination coverage in under-vaccinated populations by reinforcing the similar efficacy and safety of different measles vaccines. A multi-disciplinary team implemented a structured, evidence-based approach using failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) to identify risk factors and guide interventions in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) focusing on extremely low birth weight neonates (<750 g). The methods included the formation of a multidisciplinary task force, process measures tied to critical clinical tasks, creation of an EHR tool for real-time compliance monitoring, staff education and workflow alignment, and cultural engagement initiatives. Pre- and post-intervention data were collected and analyzed for neonates <750 g per NHSN guidelines. The main results showed that post-implementation, VAE rates decreased from 9.8 to zero per 1,000 ventilator days, achieving an SIR ?1.0 and meeting national benchmarks. Mortality among extremely low birth weight neonates declined by 60%. The authors interpreted these results as evidence that structured care bundles, integrated data tools, and multidisciplinary engagement can eliminate VAEs in high-risk neonates, which is a novel finding in the context of neonatal care. The findings can inform strategies to improve patient safety, reduce healthcare costs, and enhance outcomes systemwide by implementing standardized frameworks and education strategies across NICUs. The study is limited by its focus on a single NICU, which may affect generalisability, but the evidence is strong as it demonstrates a significant reduction in VAE rates and mortality through targeted interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过加强不同 麻疹 疫苗 的相似功效和安全性来解决全球 麻疹 病例不断上升的问题,以及提高疫苗接种不足人群中 麻疹 覆盖率的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 多学科团队采用失败模式效应分析 (FMEA) 实施结构化、基于证据的方法,以识别风险因素并指导新生儿重症监护病房 (NICU) 的干预措施,重点关注极低出生体重新生儿 (<750 g)。
elements_zh.methods: 制定了正式的 VAE 预防包,包括组建多学科工作组、与关键临床任务相关的流程措施、创建用于实时合规性监控的 EHR 工具、员工教育和工作流程调整以及文化参与举措。根据 NHSN 指南,收集并分析 <750 g 新生儿的干预前和干预后数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 实施后,VAE 率从每 1,000 个呼吸机日 9.8 降至零,实现 SIR 1.0 并达到国家基准。极低出生体重新生儿的 死亡率 下降了 60%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为结构化护理组合、综合数据工具和多学科参与可以消除高危新生儿 VAE 的证据,这是新生儿护理领域的一个新发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为改善患者安全、降低医疗成本以及通过在新生儿重症监护病房实施标准化框架和教育策略来提高全系统结果的策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注单一新生儿重症监护病房(NICU)而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它表明通过有针对性的干预措施可以显着降低 VAE 率和 死亡率。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过加强不同 麻疹 疫苗 的相似功效和安全性来解决全球 麻疹 病例不断上升的问题,以及提高疫苗接种不足人群中 麻疹 覆盖率的需要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 多学科团队采用失败模式效应分析 (FMEA) 实施结构化、基于证据的方法,以识别风险因素并指导新生儿重症监护病房 (NICU) 的干预措施,重点关注极低出生体重新生儿 (<750 g)。
analysis_zh.methods: 制定了正式的 VAE 预防包,包括组建多学科工作组、与关键临床任务相关的流程措施、创建用于实时合规性监控的 EHR 工具、员工教育和工作流程调整以及文化参与举措。根据 NHSN 指南,收集并分析 <750 g 新生儿的干预前和干预后数据。
analysis_zh.main_results: 实施后,VAE 率从每 1,000 个呼吸机日 9.8 降至零,实现 SIR 1.0 并达到国家基准。极低出生体重新生儿的 死亡率 下降了 60%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为结构化护理组合、综合数据工具和多学科参与可以消除高危新生儿 VAE 的证据,这是新生儿护理领域的一个新发现。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为改善患者安全、降低医疗成本以及通过在新生儿重症监护病房实施标准化框架和教育策略来提高全系统结果的策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其关注单一新生儿重症监护病房(NICU)而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它表明通过有针对性的干预措施可以显着降低 VAE 率和 死亡率。

S1):s188–s189 doi:10.1017/ash.2026.10734 Presentation Type: Poster Presentation Subject Category: Technology Abstract ID: 284 How Clean is Clean? Mitigation Efforts of Ice/water Dispensers Linked to a Mycobacterium chelonae Outbreak at a Pediatric Hospital Alyssa Olson1, Jean Barth1, Jenna Rasmusson1, Nicole Kriewall1, Cory Kudrna, Todd Sheley, Tyler Kramer, Jason Buckmeier and John OHoro2 1Mayo Clinic and 2Mayo Clinic College of Medicine Background: We had a large-scale measles exposure event affecting 626 patients. Management of exposed patients was urgent, involving quaran- tine, post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and symptom monitoring on a case-by-case basis. Cases were initially tracked and managed using a com- bination of multiple spreadsheets amongst stakeholders as well as lists within the electronic health record (EHR). Using shared spreadsheets and lists created significant challenges with maintaining and editing multi- ple copies and updating workbooks simultaneously. Methods: Infection Prevention and Control (IPAC) worked with primary care personnel and EHR developers to create a shared registry that would prioritize com- munication and follow-up for exposed patients based on age and immun- ity. Patients are initially added to the shared registry within the EHR by reviewing non-registry reports and tagging patients, identified using expo- sure timeframes that overlapped with the index measles cases, in a manner that transferred them to the shared registry. From this registry, measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine status can be confirmed, immune status can be identified, and criteria for PEP assigned. High-risk patients are then contacted with recommendations from IPAC and primary care. Communication and follow-up are tracked directly within the shared regis- try to ensure appropriate patient management. The exposure management registry is further leveraged throughout the measles outbreak timeframe by allowing real-time monitoring of patients that require additional precau- tions or guidance related to their exposure. Result: The shared registry enhanced documentation accuracy and transparency between stakehold- ers. It led to availability of real-time status of exposed patients for the dura- tion of the measles outbreak timeframe. Overall, the registry enabled time- sensitive patient communication to all exposed patients and rapid identi- fication of those who needed PEP. Communication could happen rapidly and seamlessly between care teams within the organization, and the nec- essary information could be shared quickly with public health authorities as required. Conclusion: Large scale exposures are a challenge to manage and ensure appropriate action and communication occurs. Errors can be prevented by having a single shared exposure management registry. A registry enables care teams to quickly identify and prioritize patients for measles follow-up, communication, PEP, and ongoing management across outbreak timeframes. This process reduces both time and operational bur- dens of exposure follow-up tracking outside of the EHR. Antimicrobial Stewardship & Healthcare Epidemiology 2026;6(Suppl. S1):s189 doi:10.1017/ash.2026.10735 Presentation Type: Poster Presentation Subject Category: Technology Abstract ID: 315 Connecting the Patients: Network Analysis of a Multi-facility Candidozyma auris Outbreak, Georgia, September 2024 – August 2025 Erin Marshall1, Michael Sayer, Christian Schneider2, Lacey Bergerhofer1 and Azadeh Wickam 1Children's Mercy and 2Children's Mercy Kansas City Background: Central line-associated bloodstream infection (CLABSI) rep- resents the most common and costly device-associated hospital-acquired infection in children. While prevention bundles are effective when reliably implemented, pediatric-specific risks often require strategies beyond stan- dard bundles. Existing CLABSI risk models are insufficient for pediatric patients, remaining static during their hospital stay despite changing clini- cal conditions. Moreover, previously reported dashboards and predictive models generally do not incorporate data science principles to provide a daily prediction score, and they often exclude demographic factors beyond age and sex. The purpose of developing the CLABSI risk model was to lev- erage technology-driven strategies for identifying, intervening, and escalat- ing care for high-risk pediatric patients in real time, thereby decreasing infection risk. Methods: Quality Improvement, Data Intelligence, and the interdisciplinary clinical team partnered to develop an evidence-based predictive model tailored to institutional risk factors. Using evidence and clinical expertise, an affinity diagram was created. Data from 61,068 in- patient central line days (January 2022- July 2024), sourced from electronic health records (EHR) and clinical surveillance software, formed the data- set. CLABSI was identified using NHSN surveillance definition. Patient risk factors from the infection date plus two days prior were evaluated. Exploratory data analysis was completed using RStudio integrated devel- opment environment to inform model development. Separate models were created for nontunneled lines and tunneled lines. Prediction models were developed using Python coding language and Databricks data intelligence platform. Under-sampling was used to account for uneven distribution between CLABSI and non-CLABSI cases. Logistic regression, random for- est, and XGBoost models were created. Candidate models were compared using area under the curve (AUC), sensitivity, and specificity. Result: Using the XGBoost model for nontunneled line, the test AUC was 0.831, demonstrating strong discriminative power. This model achieved a sensitivity of 0.828, indicating its ability to correctly identify a high pro- portion of actual CLABSI cases, and a specificity of 0.751, reflecting its capacity to correctly identify non-CLABSI cases. Similarly, the tunneled line XGBoost model yielded an AUC of 0.845, showcasing excellent pre- dictive performance. Its sensitivity was 0.833 and specificity was 0.668. In both models, the number of modifiable risks was the most significant factor (Tables 1-3). Conclusion: The CLABSI prediction model enables real-time identification and intervention to support proactive prevention, SHEA Spring 2026 Abstracts 2026;6 Suppl 1 S189

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the challenge of managing large-scale measles exposures in a pediatric hospital where rapid identification and follow-up of exposed patients were needed to prevent errors and ensure appropriate post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study described the implementation of a shared exposure management registry within an electronic health record (EHR) system at a pediatric hospital to track and manage patients exposed to measles during a large-scale outbreak affecting 626 patients.
analysis.methods: The registry was created by Infection Prevention and Control (IPAC) in collaboration with primary care personnel and EHR developers to prioritize communication and follow-up for exposed patients based on age and immunity. Patients were added to the registry by reviewing non-registry reports and tagging those within overlapping exposure timeframes, enabling confirmation of vaccine status, immune status identification, and assignment of PEP criteria.
analysis.main_results: The shared registry enhanced documentation accuracy and transparency between stakeholders, provided real-time status of exposed patients throughout the outbreak, and enabled time-sensitive patient communication and rapid identification of those needing PEP.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that large-scale exposures are difficult to manage and that errors can be prevented by using a single shared exposure management registry, which reduces operational burdens and improves efficiency in outbreak response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The registry facilitates real-time monitoring, prioritization, and management of exposed patients, supporting timely communication and PEP administration during measles outbreaks in pediatric settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single-center, retrospective implementation without comparative data to standard practices, which may affect generalizability and strength of conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the use of a shared exposure management registry within an electronic health record system to manage a large-scale measles outbreak affecting 626 pediatric patients. The registry was developed collaboratively by Infection Prevention and Control, primary care personnel, and EHR developers to prioritize follow-up based on age and immunity. Patients were added to the registry by tagging those within overlapping exposure timeframes, enabling confirmation of vaccine status, immune status identification, and assignment of post-exposure prophylaxis criteria. The registry improved documentation accuracy, transparency, and real-time monitoring of exposed patients, facilitating timely communication and rapid identification of those needing prophylaxis. The authors concluded that a single shared registry prevents errors and reduces operational burdens during large-scale exposures, though the evidence is limited to a single-center, retrospective implementation without comparative data.

elements_zh.methods: 该登记系统由感染预防和控制 (IPAC) 与初级保健人员和 EHR 开发人员合作创建,旨在根据年龄和免疫力优先考虑暴露患者的沟通和随访。通过审查非注册报告并标记重叠暴露时间范围内的患者,将患者添加到注册系统中,从而能够确认 疫苗 状态、免疫状态识别和 PEP 标准分配。
elements_zh.main_results: 共享注册表提高了利益相关者之间的文档准确性和透明度,在整个 暴发 中提供暴露患者的实时状态,并实现对时间敏感的患者沟通和快速识别需要 PEP 的患者。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,大规模暴露难以管理,并且可以通过使用单个共享暴露管理注册表来防止错误,从而减轻操作负担并提高 暴发 响应的效率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该登记系统有助于对暴露患者进行实时监测、优先排序和管理,支持儿科环境中 麻疹 麻疹 期间的及时沟通和 PEP 管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单中心、回顾性实施,没有与标准实践的比较数据,这可能会影响结论的普遍性和强度。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the challenge of managing large-scale measles exposures in a pediatric hospital where rapid identification and follow-up of exposed patients were needed to prevent errors and ensure appropriate post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP).
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study described the implementation of a shared exposure management registry within an electronic health record (EHR) system at a pediatric hospital to track and manage patients exposed to measles during a large-scale outbreak affecting 626 patients.
analysis_en.methods: The registry was created by Infection Prevention and Control (IPAC) in collaboration with primary care personnel and EHR developers to prioritize communication and follow-up for exposed patients based on age and immunity. Patients were added to the registry by reviewing non-registry reports and tagging those within overlapping exposure timeframes, enabling confirmation of vaccine status, immune status identification, and assignment of PEP criteria.
analysis_en.main_results: The shared registry enhanced documentation accuracy and transparency between stakeholders, provided real-time status of exposed patients throughout the outbreak, and enabled time-sensitive patient communication and rapid identification of those needing PEP.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that large-scale exposures are difficult to manage and that errors can be prevented by using a single shared exposure management registry, which reduces operational burdens and improves efficiency in outbreak response.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The registry facilitates real-time monitoring, prioritization, and management of exposed patients, supporting timely communication and PEP administration during measles outbreaks in pediatric settings.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single-center, retrospective implementation without comparative data to standard practices, which may affect generalizability and strength of conclusions.
